articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
articles.abstract: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved record enters the prompt. On the 1,443-task MDS-ED benchmark, PRISM achieves AUROCs of 86.2% for diagnosis, 93.1% for deterioration, 91.8% for ICU admission, and 92.8% for mortality. These results use a 96-hour pre-arrival window unavailable to reported baselines. With benchmark-window inputs only, PRISM reaches 0.8895 AUROC, compared with 0.8937 for UniPACT and 0.8889 for MDS-ED. A matched-input compact fusion model using the same five evidence streams and frozen encoders reaches 0.7652 AUROC, versus 0.9092 for PRISM. Replacing numerical EHR encoding with text serialization reduces AUROC by 3.66 points; removing pre-arrival history reduces it by 1.97 points; and zeroing retrieval reduces it by 0.99 points. Genuine retrieval outperforms random-neighbor retrieval by 0.97 macro-average points, although a paired task-level sign test does not establish a uniform advantage (p=0.067). On the external MC-MED cohort, supervised fine-tuning reaches 0.8611 AUROC, compared with 0.8227 for locally trained gradient boosting and 0.7841 for source-only PRISM. These results support structure-aware multimodal integration and supervised external adaptation.
articles.titleCn: 基于异构证据融合的临床预后检索增强型多模态语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 临床预后需要整合结构化测量、生理波形、纵向历史和群体背景。我们介绍了PRISM（Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis），一种结合了特征级数值标记化、纵向ECG的时效加权聚合以及双模态群体记忆库的多模态语言模型。检索在表示空间中操作：模型接收相似训练队列会见的平均池化嵌入，而不会将任何单个检索记录纳入提示中。在包含1443项任务的MDS-ED基准测试中，PRISM在诊断方面达到86.2%的AUC，在恶化方面达到93.1%，在ICU入院方面达到91.8%，在死亡率方面达到92.8%。这些结果使用了96小时的预到访窗口，而报道的基线模型无法使用该窗口。仅使用基准窗口输入时，PRISM达到0.8895的AUC，相比之下，UniPACT为0.8937，MDS-ED为0.8889。一个使用相同五个证据流和冻结编码的匹配输入紧凑融合模型达到0.7652的AUC，而PRISM为0.9092。将数值EHR编码替换为文本序列化将AUC降低3.66点；移除预到访历史将AUC降低1.97点；而取消检索将AUC降低0.99点。真实检索优于随机邻域检索，宏观平均分高出0.97点，尽管配对任务级符号检验未显示出统一优势（p=0.067）。在外部MC-MED队列中，监督微调达到0.8611的AUC，相比之下，本地训练的梯度提升为0.8227，仅源头的PRISM为0.7841。这些结果支持结构感知的多模态整合和监督外部适应。

articles.title: Proactive Agentic Orchestration
articles.abstract: Agentic orchestration delegates tasks to sub-agents with independent contexts, providing a key path to extending the effective execution horizon of large language model agents. However, existing orchestration methods face two limitations: in execution, current methods fix sub-agents' goals and harnesses at creation time, limiting their adaptability to dynamic real-world environments; in optimization, sparse and delayed feedback constrains effective learning of the orchestration policy. To address these limitations, we introduce POrchestra, an on-the-fly proactive agentic orchestration framework. It allows sub-agents to proactively communicate with the orchestrator at any logical point to request harness adjustments while maintaining continuity of local execution. This mechanism not only enables sub-agents to adapt seamlessly to dynamic environments but also naturally inspires On-Policy Orchestration Distillation (OPOD) based on hindsight feedback. OPOD attributes sub-agents' proactive revision requests back to preceding orchestration decisions to derive targeted improvement signals, and leverages these signals as process supervision alongside the final reward to optimize the orchestration policy. We evaluate POrchestra on three long-horizon agent benchmarks spanning deep research, dynamic digital assistance, and software engineering. POrchestra improves task success by an average of 9.1% relative to the strongest baseline; combined with OPOD, it improves small-orchestrator success by an average of 10.0% relative to existing training baselines. POrchestra also achieves a more favorable cost-performance trade-off. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/XueyangFeng/POrchestra.
articles.comment: 41 pages including references and appendices, 11 figures. Code: https://github.com/XueyangFeng/POrchestra
articles.titleCn: 主动代理编排
articles.abstractCn: 代理编排将任务分配给具有独立上下文的子代理，为扩展大型语言模型代理的有效执行范围提供了一条关键路径。然而，现有的编排方法面临两个局限性：在执行方面，当前方法在创建时固定子代理的目标和约束，限制了它们对动态真实世界环境的适应能力；在优化方面，稀疏和延迟的反馈限制了编排策略的有效学习。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了POrchestra，一个实时主动的代理编排框架。它允许子代理在任何逻辑点上主动与编排器通信，以请求调整约束，同时保持本地执行的连续性。这种机制不仅使子代理能够无缝适应动态环境，还自然地启发了基于后见之明反馈的在线策略编排蒸馏（OPOD）。OPOD将子代理的主动修订请求归因于先前的编排决策，以推导出有针对性的改进信号，并利用这些信号作为过程监督，与最终奖励一起优化编排策略。我们在三个涵盖深度研究、动态数字助理和软件工程的长期范围代理基准上评估了POrchestra。与最强的基线相比，POrchestra平均提高了9.1%的任务成功率；结合OPOD后，与现有训练基线相比，它平均提高了10.0%的小型编排器成功率。POrchestra还实现了更优的成本性能权衡。我们的代码已公开发布在https://github.com/XueyangFeng/POrchestra。

articles.title: A Better Metric Will Not Save You: What You Compare Beats How You Compare It
articles.abstract: Representational similarity measures (RSA, CKA, Procrustes) are chosen for the transformations they treat as irrelevant, and all of them take the set of conditions as given. That set is fixed by two decisions, which inputs are admitted and how they are grouped, both taken before the matrix a measure operates on exists: no invariance property reaches them. We measure what they are worth where the arrangement the conditions ought to have is known independently of the systems compared, the acoustic organisation of vowels, across fifteen languages and twenty-seven representations. Changing which categories are compared, at a fixed number of them, moves the gap between two representations by more than twice the effect being measured, while changing how many moves it not at all. In this setting rankings of models are identified under these choices, and rankings across languages are not.
articles.titleCn: 一个更好的指标不会救你：你比较的对象决定了比较的方式
articles.abstractCn: 表征相似性度量（RSA、CKA、Procrustes）被选择用于将某些变换视为无关，而所有这些度量都将条件集视为既定。这个集合由两个决定固定，即哪些输入被允许以及如何对它们进行分组，这两个决定都是在矩阵被度量操作之前做出的：没有不变性属性能触及它们。我们在已知条件应有的排列且独立于所比较系统的声学组织中测量其价值，跨越十五种语言和二十七种表示。改变比较哪些类别（在固定数量的类别中），会使两个表示之间的差距超过所测量效应的两倍，而改变比较多少则完全不会影响差距。在这种设置下，模型排名在这些选择下得以确定，而语言间的排名则无法确定。

articles.title: Towards Enriching Design-Time Models with Evidence from Simulation and Operational Activities
articles.abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems are developed through multiple model based activities, comprising several stages of development. As the development progresses through simulation, experimentation, and operation, observations of system execution may reveal missing, uncertain, or invalid design knowledge. The path from execution results to persistent design-time enrichment, however, is often implicit. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing an evidence driven workflow for systematically transferring knowledge produced during simulation and operation back into design-time models. We demonstrate the workflow using an Influence Model, a design-time artefact used to represent how design artefacts and environmental factors jointly affect system response properties, using a sign-following robot use case. We show how simulation evidence can enrich Influence Models by supporting participant pruning decisions, interaction characterisation, influence-function abstraction, and validity-scope information. The application demonstrates the feasibility of the workflow for simulation-based evidence and its potential benefits to improve design-time reasoning and feedback in subsequent development iterations.
articles.titleCn: 通过模拟和运行活动中的证据来丰富设计时模型
articles.abstractCn: 物理信息系统通过多种基于模型的活动进行开发，涵盖多个开发阶段。随着开发通过模拟、实验和运行进行，系统执行观察可能会揭示缺失、不确定或无效的设计知识。然而，从执行结果到持久设计时间增强的路径通常是隐含的。本文通过提出一个以证据驱动的流程，系统地将模拟和运行期间产生的知识反馈到设计时间模型中，来解决这一挑战。我们使用一个影响模型（Influence Model），这是一种设计时间工件，用于表示设计工件和环境因素如何共同影响系统响应属性，并以跟随标志机器人为例来展示该流程。我们展示了模拟证据如何通过支持参与者剪枝决策、交互特征描述、影响函数抽象和有效性范围信息来丰富影响模型。该应用展示了该流程在基于模拟证据方面的可行性及其在后续开发迭代中改进设计时间推理和反馈的潜在效益。

articles.title: Oído: Open-Vocabulary Speech Recognition on a $5 Microcontroller without a Neural Accelerator
articles.abstract: Speech recognition on low-cost microcontrollers is, in practice, limited to keyword spotting or a fixed list of commands. We present Oído, an inference engine that runs open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on an ESP32-S3 (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 512 KB of SRAM, 8 MB of PSRAM, 16 MB of flash, no neural accelerator). Oído executes a 13M-parameter Conformer-CTC model with int8 weights, per-frame dynamic int8 activations and int8 attention on the chip's SIMD instructions, with a schedule designed around flash and PSRAM bandwidth. On LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other the on-device arithmetic reaches 3.70%/8.23% word error rate (WER), within 0.12 points of full precision, and 3.33%/7.15% with an on-chip 1.3M-parameter language model; a transducer head gives 2.99%/6.67% and an int4 variant fits in 8.3 MB. This is 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer on the same chip, and fewer than Whisper tiny.en and Moonshine tiny in full precision on a laptop, including in real noise and reverberation. Measured on a physical board, the firmware runs at 1.97x the duration of the audio on one core, with transcripts identical to an instruction-exact emulator: accurate, but not yet real time (a 4 s command is transcribed about 8.7 s after it ends). The two-core schedule gives wrong results on silicon and is disabled. A streaming variant shows partial text while the speaker talks and delivers the final text 4.1-11.1 s after clips of 3.6-10.6 s (7.2-22.4 s in utterance mode) at 4.86%/11.03% WER; a Spanish model makes 34-60% fewer errors than multilingual Whisper tiny. Code and models are released.
articles.comment: 11 pages. Code, models and raw board measurements: https://github.com/lokutor-ai/oido
articles.titleCn: 听力：在5美元微控制器上实现开放词汇语音识别，无需神经加速器
articles.abstractCn: 在低成本微控制器上，语音识别在实践中仅限于关键词识别或固定命令列表。我们介绍了Oído，一个完全在ESP32-S3（240 MHz双核Xtensa LX7，512 KB SRAM，8 MB PSRAM，16 MB闪存，无神经加速器）上运行的开放词汇英语语音识别推理引擎。Oído使用int8权重的13M参数Conformer-CTC模型，每帧动态int8激活和芯片SIMD指令上的int8注意力，其调度方案围绕闪存和PSRAM带宽设计。在LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other测试集上，设备端算术达到3.70%/8.23%的词错误率（WER），与全精度相差0.12个点，结合1.3M参数的片上语言模型后，WER为3.33%/7.15%；转换器头给出2.99%/6.67%，int4变体则占用8.3 MB内存。这比同一芯片上供应商的识别器错误率低2.3-2.8倍，在全精度下也优于笔记本电脑上的Whisper tiny.en和Moonshine tiny，包括在真实噪声和混响环境下。在物理板上测试时，固件在单核上运行速度为音频时长1.97倍，转录结果与指令精确模拟器一致：准确但尚未实时（一个4秒的命令在结束约8.7秒后被转录）。双核调度在硅片上给出错误结果，已被禁用。流式变体在说话时显示部分文本，并在3.6-10.6秒（语句模式下为7.2-22.4秒）的音频片段后4.1-11.1秒（WER为4.86%/11.03%）交付最终文本；西班牙语模型错误率比多语言Whisper tiny低34-60%。代码和模型已开源。

articles.title: Revisiting Accent Classification with DistilHuBERT: Speaker-Disjoint Evaluation and Cross-Corpus Generalization
articles.abstract: Recent accent classification systems can achieve high accuracy in standard in-corpus evaluations. However, when speakers overlap between the training and test sets, such results may overestimate model robustness compared with real-world deployment scenarios. This study revisits the robustness of DistilHuBERT-based accent classification by using L2-ARCTIC and multiple external English accent datasets. The comparison covers file-level and speaker-disjoint splits, along with balanced external-data training and teacher-student pseudo-labeling. The large performance gap between in-corpus and external evaluations suggests that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates performance, while speaker-disjoint evaluation can provide a more realistic estimate of the generalization to unseen speakers. In this study, models trained on external data alone do not reliably generalize to L2-ARCTIC. Among the tested configurations, balanced external-data training offers the most promising supervised setting. The pseudo-labeling experiments further indicate that confidence-based filtering alone is insufficient under domain mismatch. Overall, this study suggests that robust accent classification evaluation should simultaneously include speaker-disjoint evaluation and cross-corpus testing.

articles.titleCn: 使用DistilHuBERT重新审视口音分类：无说话人差异评估和跨语料库泛化
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，语音口音分类系统在标准语料库评估中能够取得高精度。然而，当训练集和测试集存在说话人重叠时，这些结果可能会高估模型的鲁棒性，与实际部署场景相比存在偏差。本研究通过使用L2-ARCTIC和多个外部英语口音数据集重新评估了基于DistilHuBERT的口音分类的鲁棒性。比较涵盖了文件级别和说话人分离的划分，以及平衡外部数据训练和教师-学生伪标签标注。语料库内部评估与外部评估之间存在的巨大性能差距表明，文件级别评估会显著高估性能，而说话人分离评估能够提供对未见过说话人泛化能力的更真实估计。在本研究中，仅使用外部数据训练的模型无法可靠地泛化到L2-ARCTIC。在测试的配置中，平衡外部数据训练提供了最有前景的监督设置。伪标签实验进一步表明，在领域不匹配的情况下，仅基于置信度的过滤是不够的。总体而言，本研究建议鲁棒性口音分类评估应同时包含说话人分离评估和跨语料库测试。

articles.title: Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR
articles.abstract: Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns. Adapting Whisper-small from a general-domain speech corpus to the Earnings22 benchmark reveals the opposite: all evaluated methods exhibit improvement on held-out financial speech from the same domain during adaptation rather than forgetting. This task complementarity makes regularization counterproductive. Nevertheless, when regularization is warranted, a layer-wise mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) approximation seems to achieve lower word error rates (WERs) and more stable optimization than standard diagonal Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). The results suggest that task complementarity should be assessed before applying continual learning constraints, and prefer mini-KFAC EWC over diagonal EWC when needed.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Presented at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), University of Trento, Trento, Italy, September 25-26, 2026. Proceedings to appear in the ACL Anthology
articles.titleCn: 金融演讲需要持续学习正则化吗？一项关于EWC和mini-KFAC在盈利电话会议语音识别上的研究
articles.abstractCn: 财报电话会议转录呈现了一个现实的持续学习场景，其中自动语音识别（ASR）系统通过新录音进行更新，但存在遗忘先前学习过的金融语音模式的风险。将Whisper-small从通用领域语音语料库适配到Earnings22基准却揭示了相反的现象：在适配过程中，所有评估方法在来自同一领域的未持有金融语音上都表现出改进而非遗忘。这种任务互补性使得正则化变得适得其反。尽管如此，当正则化是必要的时，层级式小Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature（mini-KFAC）近似似乎实现了更低的词错误率（WER）和更稳定的优化，优于标准的对角Elastic Weight Consolidation（EWC）。结果表明，在应用持续学习约束之前应评估任务互补性，并在需要时优先选择mini-KFAC EWC而非对角EWC。

articles.title: Towards the Roof of the World: NLP Progress in Tibetan Languages
articles.abstract: Tibetan, spoken by some seven million people on and around the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, remains underrepresented in natural language processing (NLP). We present, to our knowledge, the first peer-reviewed systematic bibliometric survey of Tibetan NLP: 140 publications from 2004 to 2026 in the ACL Anthology and DBLP, annotated for venue type, research area, first-affiliation country, and resource release. Output has grown rapidly, with 84% of the publications appearing since 2018, and has expanded bottom-up along the NLP pipeline, from corpora and word segmentation through script, speech, and applications to large language models (LLMs). Researchers based in China first-authored 87% of the publications, which span all 25 represented research areas, whereas work from other countries concentrates on Classical Tibetan. We argue that this full-pipeline paradigm, realized under the compounded constraints of a complex script, dialectal diversity, and geographic remoteness, offers a reference model for other low-resource languages of the Global South. We also identify gaps in dialect coverage, responsible NLP, native and comparable evaluation, cross-community visibility, and resource release (only 29% of the publications release data, code, or models), and recommend open science, shared standards, and community participation for the LLM era.

articles.titleCn: 迈向世界屋脊：藏语自然语言处理进展
articles.abstractCn: 藏语，由青藏高原及周边地区约700万人使用，在自然语言处理（NLP）领域仍存在代表性不足的问题。据我们所知，我们首次呈现了一项关于藏语NLP的同行评审系统性文献计量调查：2004年至2026年间ACL Anthology和DBLP数据库中的140篇出版物，标注了会议类型、研究领域、第一隶属国家以及资源发布情况。输出量增长迅速，其中84%的出版物发表于2018年之后，并自下而上沿着NLP流程扩展，从语料库和分词扩展到文字、语音和应用，直至大型语言模型（LLMs）。中国的研究人员以第一作者身份撰写了87%的出版物，涵盖了所有25个代表研究领域，而其他国家的研究则主要集中在古藏语。我们认为，这种全流程范式，在复杂文字、方言多样性和地理偏远等多重约束下得以实现，为全球南方的低资源语言提供了一个参考模型。我们还识别出方言覆盖范围、负责NLP、本土及可比评估、跨社群可见性以及资源发布（仅29%的出版物发布数据、代码或模型）等方面的差距，并建议在LLM时代推动开放科学、共享标准以及社群参与。

articles.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
articles.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.
articles.titleCn: ProgramGym：为长时程程序复制代理扩展训练环境
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理正越来越多地用于像软件工程师那样从头开始构建程序，而不是用于解决存储库中的问题或根据给定的需求文档生成存储库。然而，可扩展且可验证的训练环境仍然稀缺，这些环境强制代理发现所需内容并决定系统应如何设计。此外，现有的代理工作流程也无法支持长期开发，其中代理在实施参考程序之前进行探索。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了ProgramGym，这是一个由Program-Env和Program-Agent组成的框架，用于可扩展的长期程序复现代理训练环境。具体而言，Program-Env通过反馈驱动的循环从存储库构建可验证的训练环境，该循环修复运行时沙盒构建的质量和黑盒测试的质量。使用这种新颖的流程，我们获得了涵盖C、C++、Go和Rust的1,648个训练环境。Program-Agent结合了分析、实施和审查的角色隔离工作流程，并具有用于编译检查和失败恢复的版本管理。在ProgramBench上的实验表明，Program-Env和Program-Agent都提高了程序复现的性能。在这些构建环境中进行微调将Qwen3.8-27B的性能从34.87%提高到42.84%。Program-Agent进一步将基础模型和SFT模型的性能提高到55.71%和56.25%，均超过了某些旗舰模型。我们将发布ProgramGym以支持从头开始构建程序的编码代理的进一步研究。

articles.title: MoPrO-SD: Modular Prompt Optimization for Stance Detection
articles.abstract: Stance detection remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to implicit opinions, sarcasm, and context-dependent expressions of stance. Although automatic prompt optimization offers an alternative to fine-tuning without updating model parameters, existing structured approaches are not specifically designed around stance-label semantics and class-specific ambiguities. We introduce MoPrO-SD, a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and refines them sequentially using LLM-based feedback. We study three refinement strategies: instruction-only optimization (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), and instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E), using class-conditioned errors for stance-label refinement. We also introduce VaccineStance, a new human-annotated benchmark for vaccine stance detection. Experiments across four datasets and five open-weight LLMs show that MoPrO-SD improves upon the human-written Base prompt in many settings. On SemEval-2016, class-conditioned feedback achieves higher mean Macro-F1 than pooled feedback for four of five backbones. Both reasoning-based strategies, I+R and I+R+E, achieve strong performance, with their relative effectiveness varying across models and datasets, while remaining competitive with recent prompt optimization methods. The MoPrO-SD code and VaccineStance dataset are available on GitHub.
articles.titleCn: MoPrO-SD：立场检测的模块化提示优化
articles.abstractCn: 立场检测对于大型语言模型（LLMs）来说仍然是一个挑战，因为立场表达涉及隐含观点、讽刺和依赖上下文的表达。尽管自动提示优化提供了一种无需更新模型参数的微调替代方案，但现有的结构化方法并未针对立场标签语义和类别特定歧义进行专门设计。我们引入了MoPrO-SD，这是一个针对立场进行优化的提示框架，该框架将提示分解为功能语义模块，并使用基于LLM的反馈依次对其进行细化。我们研究了三种细化策略：仅指令优化（I）、指令加推理（I+R）和指令加每例推理（I+R+E），使用类别条件错误对立场标签进行细化。我们还引入了VaccineStance，这是一个新的用于疫苗立场检测的人工标注基准。在四个数据集和五个开放权重LLM上的实验表明，MoPrO-SD在许多情况下优于人工编写的Base提示。在SemEval-2016上，类别条件反馈在五个骨干中的四个上实现了比聚合反馈更高的平均Macro-F1。基于推理的策略I+R和I+R+E均取得了优异性能，其相对有效性因模型和数据集而异，但仍然与最近的提示优化方法具有竞争力。MoPrO-SD代码和VaccineStance数据集可在GitHub上获取。

articles.title: From Structure to Validity: Mechanism-Guided Generation and Refinement of LLM Rubrics
articles.abstract: Rubrics have been widely used to evaluate and optimize language models on open-ended tasks. However, existing work primarily focuses on generating better rubrics, with limited understanding of what makes rubric design effective. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic analysis of rubric design across criterion organization, criterion operationalization, and score aggregation. Our analysis shows that structural organization enables more comprehensive criterion construction, semantic specification alone does not ensure effective criterion-level judgments, and sophisticated score aggregation provides limited additional gains. Guided by these findings, we introduce Adaptive Rubric Tree Search with Hybrid refinement (ARTS-Hybrid), which combines adaptive tree construction with semantic-first, response-calibrated refinement. Experiments across benchmarks show that ARTS-Hybrid improves both end-to-end evaluation performance and intrinsic rubric quality. Further experiments suggest that, beyond evaluation, rubrics generated by ARTS-Hybrid provide effective signals for model optimization.
articles.titleCn: 从结构到有效性：基于机制指导的语言模型评估标准的生成与优化
articles.abstractCn: 评分标准已广泛应用于开放性任务中对语言模型进行评估和优化。然而，现有工作主要集中于生成更优的评分标准，对何种设计能使评分标准有效却缺乏深入理解。在本工作中，我们对评分标准设计进行了系统性的机制分析，涵盖标准组织、标准操作化和评分聚合三个方面。我们的分析表明，结构化组织能实现更全面的标准构建，仅靠语义规范并不能确保有效的标准级判断，而复杂的评分聚合提供的额外收益有限。基于这些发现，我们提出了自适应评分树搜索与混合细化（ARTS-Hybrid）方法，该方法结合了自适应树构建与语义优先、响应校准的细化。跨基准的实验表明，ARTS-Hybrid提升了端到端评估性能和内在评分标准质量。进一步的实验表明，除了评估之外，ARTS-Hybrid生成的评分标准为模型优化提供了有效的信号。

articles.title: Overcoming Data Imbalances with Expert Selection Biases
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the standard architecture for frontier LLMs. The multiple parallel experts in each transformer block theoretically enable expert specialization according to categories such as domains, languages, or modalities during pretraining. However, when data is imbalanced across categories, minority categories can become concentrated in a small fraction of the expert pool or spread inefficiently across them, effectively limiting their available capacity. In this work, we demonstrate that category-conditioned expert-selection biases can preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools. By applying biases based on input category, we provide a simple way to induce soft category-aligned specialization. This intervention encourages categories toward distinct expert subsets while retaining cross-category sharing when useful. More importantly, it enables the over-allocation of expert capacity to categories that would otherwise be disadvantaged by data scarcity. We observe performance improvements across modalities, low-resource languages, and code in models up to 10.6B parameters. At our smallest and largest model scales, these gains are equivalent to allocating 18.5% and 2.7% additional baseline training tokens, respectively. Overall, our results show that expert biases can serve as a lightweight control for category-level expert allocation, making room for low-resource categories while retaining standard MoE inference.
articles.titleCn: 通过专家选择偏差克服数据不平衡
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）模型已成为前沿大型语言模型的标准架构。每个Transformer模块中的多个并行专家理论上能够在预训练期间根据领域、语言或模态等类别实现专家专业化。然而，当数据在类别间分布不平衡时，少数类别可能会集中在专家池的一小部分，或低效地分散在它们之间，从而有效限制了其可用容量。在这项工作中，我们证明类别条件专家选择偏差可以优先将不同类别的标记路由到专业化的专家池。通过应用基于输入类别的偏差，我们提供了一种简单的方法来诱导软类别对齐专业化。这种干预鼓励类别向不同的专家子集发展，同时在需要时保留跨类别共享。更重要的是，它使专家容量能够过度分配给因数据稀缺而处于劣势的类别。我们观察到在参数量高达10.6B的模型中，跨模态、低资源语言和代码的性能均得到提升。在我们规模最小和最大的模型中，这些增益分别相当于额外分配了18.5%和2.7%的基线训练标记。总体而言，我们的结果表明专家偏差可以作为类别级专家分配的轻量级控制手段，为低资源类别腾出空间，同时保留标准的MoE推理。

articles.title: Test-Time Memory Construction
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to answer questions over long interaction histories, where relevant evidence may be scattered across distant sessions. Existing memory systems typically construct and maintain sophisticated memory representations offline, before user queries are observed, incurring substantial overhead and limiting their ability to adapt memory construction to query-specific information needs. In this paper, we propose T$^2$Mem, a Test-Time Memory construction framework that defers memory construction to inference and progressively builds memory along the reasoning process. Specifically, T$^2$Mem extracts lightweight episode-level metadata offline to capture key events and temporal associations as retrieval cues, while retaining links to the original interactions to facilitate the reconstruction of dependencies across episodes. At test time, the LLM adaptively retrieves and organizes metadata and raw interactions, progressively constructing query-specific memory as reasoning unfolds. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show the effectiveness of T$^2$Mem by consistently outperforming strong baselines across different backbone LLMs while substantially reducing the overhead of memory construction. Further analysis demonstrates that deferring memory construction to inference enables the memory construction process to dynamically adapt to the information needs of individual queries. All code is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/T2Mem.
articles.titleCn: 测试时内存构建
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理长交互历史中的问题时面临挑战，其中相关证据可能分散在不同会话中。现有的记忆系统通常在观察到用户查询之前离线构建并维护复杂的记忆表示，这带来了巨大的开销，并限制了它们根据查询特定信息需求调整记忆构建的能力。在本文中，我们提出了T$^2$Mem，一个测试时记忆构建框架，该框架将记忆构建推迟到推理阶段，并在推理过程中逐步构建记忆。具体而言，T$^2$Mem离线提取轻量级的片段级元数据，以捕获关键事件和时间关联作为检索线索，同时保留与原始交互的链接，以促进跨片段依赖关系的重建。在测试时，LLM自适应地检索和组织元数据和原始交互，随着推理的展开逐步构建特定于查询的记忆。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，T$^2$Mem通过在不同骨干LLMs上始终优于强基线，同时显著降低了记忆构建的开销，证明了其有效性。进一步的分析表明，将记忆构建推迟到推理阶段使记忆构建过程能够动态适应单个查询的信息需求。所有代码可在https://github.com/OpenBMB/T2Mem获取。

articles.title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
articles.abstract: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.
articles.titleCn: 探索扩散模型和自回归模型中文本到图像转换器中的注意力汇流
articles.abstractCn: 注意力吸引点是那些持续获得与其语义内容不符的注意力质量的标记或位置。尽管在大语言模型中对此已进行了广泛研究，但它们在文本到图像（T2I）Transformer中的行为和功能相关性仍基本未得到探索。为了填补这一空白并更好地理解文本到图像Transformer如何分配和路由注意力，我们研究了文本到图像Transformer在双向扩散模型和因果自回归模型中的这一现象。具体而言，我们探讨了是否存在注意力吸引点、它们何时出现以及它们如何功能性地影响生成。通过系统的注意力分析和针对性的干预措施，我们发现注意力吸引点在双向扩散和自回归模型中都出现，但表现出不同的模式。自回归模型将注意力集中在第一个和全局尺度的标记上，而双向模型则在模态边界附近、文本区域和空间角落附近形成吸引点。此外，这些模式在生成阶段有所不同，并且局限于稀疏的层和头子集。为了评估它们的功能相关性，我们扰动与吸引点相关的头子和标记位置。结果表明，扰动吸引点排名的头子产生的平均变化比非吸引点比较更大，而某些吸引点位置的扰动对双向模型评分的影响有限。我们进一步引入了注册标记来重新分配注意力吸引点，发现几种配置可以保持或适度提高生成性能。总体而言，注意力吸引点是依赖于架构、推理阶段和组件的现象，为文本到图像Transformer中的机制分析和原则性注意力设计提供了基础。

articles.title: Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving
articles.abstract: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.
articles.titleCn: 将分词从主机中移除以实现智能体LLM服务
articles.abstractCn: 代理工作负载会重新发送在调用之间几乎未发生变化的较长上下文。前缀缓存现在跳过了它们的大部分预填充，但每个请求在缓存被查询之前仍需完整地进行分词。分词，这个长期以来被视为可忽略不计的CPU阶段，已成为首次获取token时间（TTFT）的最大部分，而前端为整个GPU集群进行分词会限制其能够处理的GPU数量。我们提出了GraphTok，一个GPU分词器，它将整个编码管道，从预分词到字节对编码（BPE）合并再到token-ID组装，作为一个可重放的CUDA图来运行。GraphTok在GPT-2、Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、DeepSeek-V3和Gemma 3上以比特级精确度复制了参考token ID，将短输入交给CPU引擎（GPU无法胜出），并兼容未修改的vLLM和NVIDIA Dynamo。GraphTok在1.7-3.2毫秒内（包括数据传输）编码了100万个GPT-2 token，在Llama 3上比最强大的CPU分词器gigatoken快4.7-6.0倍。在TokTier自己的单请求基准测试中，它比gigatoken快2.6-3.9倍，比TokTier快高达18.1倍。在带有缓存的vLLM中，它将平均TTFT降低了2.1-2.4倍。最大的收益是容量。在2秒P99目标内，一个使用GraphTok的Dynamo前端能够维持518个请求/秒的121k-token流量，这是56个GPU最繁忙时段的负载，而gigatoken只能维持296个请求，默认分词器只能维持18.5个请求。在121k到一百万token之间，这是gigatoken维持负载的1.75-2.5倍，在gigatoken尾部断裂时，P99低至64倍。

articles.title: Host-Aware Web Crawling for LLM Pretraining Data
articles.abstract: Web crawling is a major source of large language model (LLM) pretraining data, yet data-selection pipelines discard a large share of crawled pages. We investigate how a crawler should allocate its budget across and within hosts to collect more high-quality pretraining data. Combining document-level quality classifier scores, web-graph centrality metrics, and Common Crawl's per-host crawl coverage, we find that roughly half of the variation in classifier scores occurs between hosts. In the crawls we analyze, a few pages from a host also provide a useful estimate of the quality of its remaining pages. Common Crawl uses harmonic centrality, a graph centrality metric, to guide its crawl allocation. In our simulations, using centrality to choose which hosts to crawl yields limited gains over random ordering and performs worse for some classifiers. For deciding how deeply to crawl each host, sampling a few pages and then fetching more from hosts with higher-scoring samples collects several times more high-quality pages per fetch than uniform depth or centrality-based allocation. Finally, Common Crawl's observed per-host coverage has little correlation with the evaluated quality signals. We estimate that tens of millions of high-quality pages remain among known but uncrawled URLs in each crawl examined, with most concentrated on a small share of hosts.
articles.titleCn: 面向主机的网络爬虫用于LLM预训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 网络爬虫是大型语言模型（LLM）预训练数据的主要来源，然而数据选择流程会丢弃大量爬取到的页面。我们研究了爬虫应如何分配预算跨主机和主机内部以收集更多高质量的预训练数据。结合文档级质量分类器得分、网页图中心度指标以及Common Crawl的每主机爬取覆盖率，我们发现分类器得分的大约一半变化发生在主机之间。在我们分析的那些爬取中，来自一个主机的少量页面也能有效估计其剩余页面的质量。Common Crawl使用调和中心度这一图中心度指标来指导其爬取分配。在我们的模拟中，使用中心度来选择要爬取的主机相较于随机排序仅带来有限收益，并且在某些分类器上表现更差。对于决定每个主机的爬取深度，先采样少量页面，然后从得分较高的样本所在主机获取更多页面，每获取一次能收集到比均匀深度或基于中心度的分配多几倍的优质页面。最后，Common Crawl观察到的每主机覆盖率与评估的质量信号几乎没有相关性。我们估计在每个被检查的爬取中，已知但未爬取的URL中仍有数千万优质页面，其中大部分集中在少数主机上。

articles.title: Agreement Without Alignment: Label-Free Rubric Clarification Increases LLM-Judge Consensus but Not Agreement with Humans
articles.abstract: LLM judges are increasingly deployed as panels, and disagreement among panel members is often read as a symptom of an unclear rubric. We test a label-free procedure that turns this disagreement into rubric repairs. The procedure decomposes each rubric into sub-criteria, ranks them by cross-judge disagreement on a development split, and has an editor model rewrite only the most contested ones. An additional stage that moves text-checkable sub-criteria to deterministic checkers transferred none in our evaluation. Human labels are never used to select or edit clauses; they are used only to evaluate the outcome. We pre-specified four hypotheses in a version-controlled protocol and evaluated six rubric conditions with a panel of five judges from three providers on SummEval, the HealthBench meta-evaluation, and USR Topical-Chat, for a total of 129,770 judge requests, excluding retries. On SummEval, the procedure raised inter-judge Krippendorff's $α$ by 0.069 (95% CI 0.046 to 0.092) over the original rubric and by 0.074 over a control that applied the same edits to an equal number of randomly chosen clauses that were not selected. Agreement with expert ratings showed no detectable change (Kendall $τ$ difference -0.007, 95% CI -0.037 to 0.021). On HealthBench and USR, neither inter-judge agreement nor human agreement met the preregistered effect criteria. In a preregistered secondary comparison, human agreement after editing the contested clauses was lower than after editing the control clauses on all three datasets in point estimate, although no interval excluded zero. Selecting clauses by disagreement makes judges agree with each other more than editing arbitrary clauses does, but in our setting the added consensus did not bring the judges closer to human annotators. We will release code, frozen rubrics, item identifiers, and judge scores.
articles.titleCn: 无一致性协议：无标签评分标准的澄清提升了大语言模型与裁判者的一致性，但未提升其与人类的一致性
articles.abstractCn: LLM评委越来越多地被部署为评审小组，而评审小组成员之间的分歧通常被视为评审标准不明确的表现。我们测试了一种无标签的流程，将这种分歧转化为对评审标准的修订。该流程将每个评审标准分解为子标准，根据开发集上的跨评委分歧对其进行排序，并由编辑模型仅重写最具争议的部分。我们评估了一个额外的阶段，该阶段将文本可检查的子标准转移到确定性检查器，但在我们的评估中未转移任何内容。人类标签从未被用于选择或编辑条款；它们仅用于评估结果。我们在版本控制的协议中预先指定了四个假设，并在SummEval、HealthBench元评估和USR Topical-Chat上使用来自三家提供者的五人评审小组评估了六个评审条件，总共129,770个评委请求，不包括重试。在SummEval上，该流程使评委间Krippendorff's α提高了0.069（95% CI 0.046至0.092），比原始评审标准提高了0.074，比一个对同等数量的随机选择条款（未选择条款）应用相同编辑的控制组更高。与专家评分的一致性没有出现可检测到的变化（Kendall τ差异 -0.007，95% CI -0.037至0.021）。在HealthBench和USR上，评委间的一致性或人类一致性均未达到预先注册的效果标准。在一个预先注册的次要比较中，在三个数据集上，编辑争议条款后的人类一致性在点估计上低于编辑控制条款后，尽管没有区间排除零。通过分歧选择条款使评委之间比编辑任意条款时更一致，但在我们的设置中，增加的共识并未使评委更接近人类标注者。我们将发布代码、冻结的评审标准、项目标识符和评委评分。

articles.title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
articles.abstract: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays below 1 point, and exact match rises further. Two simple gates fail the preregistered criterion. The side effect is narrower than hypothesized: optimized prompts are more accurate and break an explicit output contract, and a lenient target metric does not show the cost.
articles.titleCn: 提示优化器是否会破坏未对其评分的要求？一项预先注册的研究
articles.abstractCn: 提示优化器会重写提示以提高一个目标指标，但提示还会声明目标指标未评分的要求，例如输出格式、引用或回避。在一项预先注册的研究中，我们在HotpotQA、SQuAD 2.0和IFEval上运行GEPA、MIPROv2和TextGrad，并使用确定性检查统计每项未评分要求的违规情况。根据预先注册的标准，这三个优化器都产生了回归，在HotpotQA上尤为显著，其中引用有效性的净回归达到10.7到41.6分，而精确匹配则上升了21到34分。事后分解改变了这一解读。优化的提示在所需JSON对象之前引出推理，在整个研究中使用的200词输出限制下，13.9%到47.0%的响应在任何答案出现前就结束了。在可解析的输出中，净回归在零点附近3分以内。使用1024词限制时，提取失败消失，内容回归保持在1分以下，精确匹配进一步上升。两个简单的门限未能通过预先注册的标准。副作用比预期的要小：优化的提示更准确，但违反了明确的输出合同，而宽松的目标指标并未显示出代价。

articles.title: BoundaryEvo: Data-Model Co-Evolution at the Capability Boundary for Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation
articles.abstract: Distilling long-chain reasoning trajectories from large teacher models provides an effective way to improve the reasoning ability of small language models. However, existing methods typically select a fixed training set before distillation, overlooking that the usefulness of a reasoning example changes as the student evolves. This mismatch becomes especially costly when only a small number of teacher trajectories can be used for training. Besides, examples already mastered provide little new supervision, while examples far beyond the capability of student may be difficult to learn from. Training data should therefore adapt as model capability evolves, yet reliable data selection is difficult when the student is initially weak. To address these challenges, our key idea is to first establish the basic reasoning capability and then adapt the training data to the evolving capability boundary of the student. We propose BoundaryEvo, a two-stage data--model co-evolution framework. In Capability Priming, we directly distill a small set of teacher-generated long reasoning trajectories without using a separate model to judge and filter them, allowing the student to acquire an initial reasoning capability before capability-aware data selection. In Capability-Boundary Co-Evolution, we repeatedly select questions that the current student has not mastered but the expert can reliably solve, and update the training data as the student evolves. With only 1,000 training examples, BoundaryEvo consistently outperforms static and dynamic data selection baselines across 11 reasoning benchmarks, raising the original Qwen3.5-4B accuracy from 62.9 to 75.3 on IMO-AnswerBench and from 26.8 to 46.0 on AMO-Bench. The code and data will be made publicly available.
articles.titleCn: BoundaryEvo：长链推理蒸馏能力边界上的数据模型协同进化
articles.abstractCn: 从大型教师模型中蒸馏长链推理轨迹为提升小型语言模型的推理能力提供了一种有效方法。然而，现有方法通常在蒸馏前选择固定的训练集，忽略了推理示例的有效性会随着学生模型的进化而变化。这种不匹配在只有少量教师轨迹可用于训练时尤为昂贵。此外，已经掌握的示例提供的监督信息有限，而远超学生能力的示例可能难以学习。因此，训练数据应随模型能力的提升而调整，但在学生初始能力较弱时，可靠的数据选择却十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们的核心思路是首先建立基本的推理能力，然后根据学生不断变化的能界调整训练数据。我们提出了BoundaryEvo，一个两阶段数据-模型协同进化框架。在能力初始化阶段，我们直接蒸馏一小部分教师生成的长推理轨迹，无需使用单独的模型进行判断和筛选，使学生在能力感知数据选择前获得初始推理能力。在能力边界协同进化阶段，我们反复选择当前学生尚未掌握但专家能可靠解决的题目，并随着学生的进化更新训练数据。仅用1,000个训练示例，BoundaryEvo在11个推理基准上始终优于静态和动态数据选择基线，将原始Qwen3.5-4B在IMO-AnswerBench上的准确率从62.9提升至75.3，在AMO-Bench上的准确率从26.8提升至46.0。代码和数据将公开提供。

articles.title: Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence
articles.abstract: Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Most embedding-based retrievers compare single-vector representations of queries and memories, even when relevance depends on a small part of the content. Such local evidence can be matched to queries using the contextual token representations already computed by the same embedding models. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. An optional low-rank query adapter can be trained with supervision while keeping the encoder and stored memory representations fixed. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further increases the gains to 13.3 and 14.3 percentage points in average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on Qwen3-Embedding-4B. These retrieval gains translate into higher question-answering accuracy on long-term memory benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 超越最终嵌入：从标记级证据中检索记忆
articles.abstractCn: 记忆增强助手从存储的对话和文档中检索证据以回答查询。大多数基于嵌入的检索器即使相关性取决于内容的一小部分，也会比较查询和记忆的单向量表示。这种局部证据可以使用由相同的嵌入模型预先计算的上下文标记表示与查询进行匹配。我们的方法使用稀疏标记匹配来在不进行额外训练的情况下改进检索。每个查询标记会从候选记忆中检索一小组匹配标记。匹配分数会为每个记忆进行聚合，并与整体记忆相似度结合进行排序。可选的低秩查询适配器可以在保持编码器和存储的记忆表示固定的情况下，使用监督进行训练。我们的方法在不进行额外训练的情况下，在八个基准测试和多款模型系列上提高了检索性能。查询适配器进一步将平均 Recall@10 和 NDCG@10 在 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 上的增益提高了 13.3 和 14.3 个百分点。这些检索增益转化为在长期记忆基准测试上更高的问答准确率。

articles.title: CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.
articles.titleCn: 角色：跨分词器离线策略蒸馏的信用对齐
articles.abstractCn: 跨分词器在线蒸馏（OPD）需要在教师序列和学生序列比较分数之前进行对齐。解码文本对齐在片段级别提供了这种对应关系，但留下了一个尚未解决的问题：信用对齐。片段级别的信号指定了跨度应如何变化，但并未说明该信号应如何分布到学生标记上，而无教师对应关系的标记则不受约束。我们提出了CAST（片段感知信用分配与选择性标记锚定），一个位移或保持框架，解决了这两个问题。对于对齐的片段，CAST使用预测不确定性和局部教师信号平滑度将每个片段的优势重新分配到学生标记上，强调由局部一致教师反馈支持的学习机会，同时保留片段的总优势。由此产生的权重精确地解决了KL正则化的信用分配问题。对于未对齐的位置，CAST通过KL惩罚选择性地将学生锚定到其初始策略，限制在教师监督不可用时出现的漂移。由于信用分配与片段构建分离，CAST也适用于分词定义或固定长度的片段。在六个数学、科学和代码基准测试中，CAST将跨分词器迁移从Qwen3-8B到Mistral-7B和Llama-3.1-8B的平均性能分别提高了2.45和1.32分，并将共享分词器迁移到Qwen3-1.7B提高了2.10分。

articles.title: Vision Transformers Learn Word Meaning from Images Alone
articles.abstract: Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. DINOv3-H and DINOv3-7B are, to our knowledge, the first self-supervised vision models to show substantial semantic structure for rendered words. Comparisons with text and speech encoders reveal shared structure among representations of the same words. Contrastive alignment with either encoder further strengthened DINOv3-H's word-level semantic structure, while leaving the other finetuned vision models largely unchanged. Image-only training can therefore teach vision models not just what words look like, but also how their meanings relate.
articles.titleCn: 视觉Transformer仅从图像中学习词语含义
articles.abstractCn: 一个视觉模型能否仅从像素中学习词语的含义？我们展示了两个最大的DINOv3视觉Transformer能够根据词语含义组织图像中的词语呈现，尽管它们仅使用图像进行自监督预训练，而没有配对的标题、类别标签或其他语言监督。我们从词语图像与匹配对照的嵌入差异中推导出词语表示，然后测试语义相关的词语是否在每个模型的嵌入空间中是邻居，同时控制拼写相似性。我们发现同一行业的品牌名称会聚集在一起，来自同一语义域的名词也是如此。国家首都对表现出与文本训练的词语嵌入相似的稳定向量偏移。这些词语表示也与它们所命名的视觉对象类别的表示相一致。据我们所知，DINOv3-H和DINOv3-7B是首批展示渲染词语显著语义结构的自监督视觉模型。与文本和语音编码器的比较揭示了相同词语表示之间的共享结构。与任一编码器的对比对齐进一步增强了DINOv3-H的词语级语义结构，而其他微调视觉模型基本未发生变化。因此，仅使用图像训练不仅能让视觉模型学会词语的外观，还能学会它们含义之间的关系。

articles.title: What Do Audio-Language Judges of Generated Music Listen For? Four Probes with Controls from Expert Ratings
articles.abstract: Open audio-language models are used as judges of generated music: given a clip and its text prompt, the model rates the clip, and the judge is validated by how well its ratings correlate with expert ratings. The correlation does not show what the judge responds to: the music, the text prompt, or the way the question is asked. We propose four probes that test each of these, three of them read against a control computed from the human ratings: removing the audio, replacing the clip with another model's clip for the same prompt, swapping the order of two clips in pairwise judging, and rewording the instruction. We apply them to five open judges on all 2,748 clips of MusicEval, and the last two to the SongEval songs. Without audio, no judge exceeds what the prompt alone predicts from the human ratings, and for prompt alignment every judge falls below it. With audio, every judge follows the clip it hears when rating prompt alignment, two do when rating musical quality, and the strongest judge's quality score tracks the experts' alignment rating more than their quality rating. The pairwise verdicts of the four smaller judges follow the position of a clip in the pair (its slot) rather than its quality on both rating sets. For musical quality, rewording the instruction moves the correlation of most judges as much as changing the judge. MusicEval's prompt assignment bounds any prompt-only judge at the model level. We recommend reporting the four probes with every music judge.
articles.titleCn: 生成音乐的音频语言评委听什么？来自专家评级的四个带控制探针
articles.abstractCn: 开放音频语言模型被用作生成音乐的评判者：给定一个片段及其文本提示，模型对片段进行评分，并通过其评分与专家评分的相关性来验证评判者的有效性。相关性并不能表明评判者响应的是音乐、文本提示还是提问方式。我们提出了四种探测方法，分别测试这三种情况，其中三种与根据人类评分计算的控制组进行比较：移除音频、用另一个模型生成的相同提示的片段替换当前片段、交换成对评判中两个片段的顺序，以及重述指令。我们将这些方法应用于MusicEval所有2,748个片段的五个开放评判者，并将后两种方法应用于SongEval歌曲。移除音频后，没有评判者的评分超过仅根据提示预测的人类评分，而在提示一致性方面，所有评判者的评分都低于该预测值。保留音频时，所有评判者在评判提示一致性时会遵循所听到的片段，在评判音乐质量时有两者会遵循所听到的片段，而最强评判者的质量评分与专家的提示一致性评分的相关性高于其质量评分。四个较小评判者的成对评判结果遵循片段在成对评判中的位置（其槽位），而非其在两个评分集中的质量。在音乐质量方面，重述指令会导致大多数评判者的相关性变化与更换评判者相当。MusicEval的提示分配将任何仅基于提示的评判者在模型层面进行了限制。我们建议在每次音乐评判报告中都包含这四种探测方法。

articles.title: How Reliable are AMR Parser Outputs? Uncertainty Estimation for AMR Parsing
articles.abstract: Recent advances have significantly improved the performance of Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) parsers, yet determining when their outputs can be trusted remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first study of uncertainty estimation for AMR parsers in a black-box setting using top-k beam-search candidates. Uncertainty is estimated from pairwise candidate similarities and evaluated using the Prediction Rejection Ratio. This work characterises the relationship between parsing performance and uncertainty, evaluates the reliability of beam candidate distributions, analyses the effect of evaluation metrics on uncertainty assessment, and identifies parsers that provide the strongest balance between performance and reliability. Experimental results show the value of uncertainty estimation as a complementary dimension for evaluating AMR parsers.
articles.titleCn: AMR解析器输出的可靠性如何？AMR解析的不确定性估计
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，抽象意义表示（AMR）解析器的性能已得到显著提升，但判断其输出何时可信赖仍基本未得到探索。本研究首次在黑盒环境下，使用top-k束搜索候选对AMR解析器的模糊度估计进行了研究。模糊度通过成对候选相似度进行估计，并使用预测拒绝率进行评估。本研究刻画了解析性能与模糊度之间的关系，评估了束候选分布的可靠性，分析了评估指标对模糊度评估的影响，并识别出在性能和可靠性之间取得最佳平衡的解析器。实验结果表明，模糊度估计作为评估AMR解析器的补充维度具有重要价值。

articles.title: SharP: Soft and Hard Prompt-Guided Augmentation with LLM for Low Resource Fake News Detection
articles.abstract: Fake news detection under low resource conditions is challenged by the scarcity of labeled data and the difficulty of capturing subtle deceptive patterns. In this work, we focus on low resource fake news detection, where only a small labeled set is available for training, while evaluation is performed under a fixed and unchanged test protocol. This setting is motivated by costly, ambiguous fact-checking and emerging topics and domains that are poorly covered by existing benchmarks. Existing data augmentation methods, such as synonym substitution, generative adversarial networks, and large language model (LLM)-based generation, often produce fluent but overly generic content, lacking the task-specific relevance needed for accurate detection. To address this, we propose SharP, a boundary-aware text generation framework guided by soft and hard prompts, which leverages LLMs as tools adapted to produce task-specific synthetic samples. SharP employs a dual prompt mechanism: hard prompts provide structured guidance and factual constraints, while soft prompts introduce learned semantic patterns from the data. These two types of prompts are combined to guide the generation process, enabling the model to produce samples that closely align with the characteristics of news. To further enhance detection performance, we incorporate a boundary-aware strategy that steers generation toward areas where the classifier is less confident, helping to clarify subtle distinctions between real and fake content. In addition, we adopt a dual objective optimization that balances semantic alignment with the source data and classifier feedback. This encourages the generation of samples that are both domain-consistent and helpful for refining decision boundaries, ultimately improving model robustness and generalization in low resource fake news detection.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Author manuscript. Code: https://github.com/Fujizzz/SharP
articles.titleCn: SharP：基于LLM的软硬提示引导增强技术在低资源假新闻检测中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 在低资源条件下进行假新闻检测面临着标注数据稀缺以及难以捕捉微妙欺骗模式的挑战。在本工作中，我们专注于低资源假新闻检测，其中仅有一小部分标注数据用于训练，而评估则在一个固定且不变的测试协议下进行。这种设置是由昂贵的、模糊的事实核查以及现有基准难以覆盖的新兴主题和领域所驱动的。现有的数据增强方法，如同义词替换、生成对抗网络以及基于大型语言模型（LLM）的生成，通常会产生流畅但过于泛化的内容，缺乏任务特定的相关性，从而难以进行准确检测。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SharP，一个边界感知的文本生成框架，该框架在软硬提示的指导下利用LLM作为工具来生成任务特定的合成样本。SharP采用双重提示机制：硬提示提供结构化指导和事实约束，而软提示引入从数据中学习到的语义模式。这两种类型的提示被结合起来指导生成过程，使模型能够生成与新闻特征高度一致的样本。为了进一步提升检测性能，我们结合了边界感知策略，将生成引导至分类器信心不足的区域，帮助区分真实与虚假内容之间的微妙差异。此外，我们采用双重目标优化，平衡与源数据的语义一致性以及分类器反馈。这鼓励生成既符合领域一致性又有助于细化决策边界的样本，最终提升模型在低资源假新闻检测中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

articles.title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.
articles.titleCn: S$^3$R：通过自稀疏推测解码实现快速且可靠的强化学习 rollout
articles.abstractCn: 针对长上下文强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中的快速策略生成，需要在不改变用于策略优化的响应组的情况下减少KV缓存流量。在我们的RLVR工作负载分析中，注意力机制占自回归解码内核时间的72--76%。稀疏注意力可以减少这些读取操作，但直接从稀疏策略中采样会改变用于学习的响应组。对于组相对优化，我们证明即使进行精确的响应权重调整，通常也无法恢复预期的密集策略更新，因为每个响应的优势取决于其他组成员的奖励。我们提出了自稀疏推测策略生成（S$^3$R）。它使用稀疏注意力来提议标记，然后通过全注意力验证和精确推测采样来生成响应。起草和验证共享相同的策略参数，无需训练或更新单独的起草器。生成的响应组遵循密集策略的分布。在S$^3$R下，我们分析了加速条件以及起草和验证的成本。我们发现密集验证仍然需要完整的歷史KV缓存。因此，KV感知调度器限制了KV缓存的重复卸载和恢复，同时保持策略生成的并行性。在匹配的消融实验中，与激进的稀疏起草预算相比，S$^3$R在保持稳定训练的同时，直接稀疏采样结合训练端校正变得不稳定。在长上下文数学推理任务中，S$^3$R在Qwen3模型上实现了自回归策略生成的1.39倍1.35倍的端到端训练吞吐量，且任务性能相当。

articles.title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
articles.abstract: Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.
articles.titleCn: JANUS：通过协同进化的世界模型增强长时程自主研究
articles.abstractCn: 长期自主研究已展现出通过持续假设生成、实施与验证的循环加速科学进步的潜力。然而，这种生成-执行-反馈范式依赖于反应式试错，其中昂贵且耗时的执行引入了严重的反馈延迟，在搜索空间爆炸式扩展下限制了进化进程。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了JANUS框架，该框架通过一个由协同进化世界模型驱动的预测-验证-进化循环，统一了未来结果预测和过去经验反思。在一个动态演化的图中，研究智能体提出候选方案，而世界模型通过预测价值提升、信息增益和探索效用来评分，并在执行前相应地选择、优化或修剪分支。在接收真实反馈后，JANUS将经验提炼为动态演化的技能：为研究智能体提供层级技能，为世界模型提供探索策略技能，以及它们之间的协调协议。该机制实现了持续协同进化：研究智能体在候选方案生成上精益求精，而世界模型在长期范围内不断优化其预测判断。在MLS-Bench-Lite和真实研究任务上的大量评估表明，JANUS显著优于现有最佳基线，实现了更高的进化效率和上限。

articles.title: PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling
articles.abstract: Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next proposal is generated. Prior work reduces this cost by changing the sampler or the model (e.g., sequential Monte Carlo, approximate lookahead, distillation). We propose Predictive SubTree Prefetching (PreSTO), which accelerates PowerMH by prefetching future proposals and provably leaves its MH transition kernel unchanged. PreSTO views future MH outcomes as a tree of accept/reject decisions: in each model call, it generates the proposals of a \textit{prefetched subtree} of this tree in one batch, then follows the realized path with the original MH acceptance rule. We also observe that MH reaches only a sparse, nearly unary part of each prefetched subtree, we further design a \textit{predictive traversal rule} that chooses the subtree to maximize the predicted number of completed transitions. Across seven datasets and five base LLMs, PreSTO achieves median speedups of $1.71\times$, $1.91\times$, and $2.33\times$ on PowerMH and its follow-ups EntropyCut and MultiTryMH, respectively; on the first two, it makes a median of $3.9\times$ fewer model calls, each only $2.1\times$ longer. On LCB V6 with Qwen3.5-9B, the predictive traversal rule is a further $1.25\times$--$1.37\times$ faster than the default breadth-first traversal.
articles.titleCn: PreSTO：用于快速LLM功率采样的预测性子树预取
articles.abstractCn: 功率采样通过从基础模型分布的锐化版本中采样来提升大型语言模型（LLM）在测试时的推理能力。其采样器PowerMH之所以缓慢，是因为其Metropolis-Hastings（MH）更新是顺序执行的：每次接受/拒绝决策都设定了下一次提议生成的状态。先前工作通过改变采样器或模型（例如，顺序蒙特卡洛、近似前瞻、蒸馏）来降低这种成本。我们提出了预测子树预取（PreSTO），通过预取未来的提议来加速PowerMH，并证明其MH转移核保持不变。PreSTO将未来的MH结果视为一个接受/拒绝决策的树：在每次模型调用中，它批量生成该树的一个预取子树的提议，然后按照原始MH接受规则遵循实际路径。我们还观察到MH仅达到每个预取子树中稀疏的、近似一元的部分，我们进一步设计了一种预测遍历规则，该规则选择能最大化预测完成转换数量的子树。在七个数据集和五个基础LLM上，PreSTO在PowerMH及其后续的EntropyCut和MultiTryMH上分别实现了1.71倍、1.91倍和2.33倍的中位数加速；在前两个数据集上，它使模型调用次数中位数减少了3.9倍，且每次调用仅比原始方法长2.1倍。在LCB V6与Qwen3.5-9B上，预测遍历规则比默认的广度优先遍历快1.25倍至1.37倍。

articles.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
articles.abstract: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.
articles.titleCn: 为长时程终端智能扩展代理数据
articles.abstractCn: 终端代理正从本地操作转向完成现实世界中的专业任务。短时轨迹可以展示指令和工具调用，但它们并未完全展示代理如何通过探索积累证据、利用证据进行判断、根据反馈持续调整策略，以及将中间结果转化为最终交付成果。高质量的长期轨迹能够捕捉这些代理行为模式及其在单一问题解决过程中的关联，为持续自主工作提供更丰富的体验。然而，环境合成可能在构建过程中预先完成或简化这些模式背后的关键工作，从而消除了代理本应进行的探索、实施和验证需求。为应对这一问题，我们引入了TerminalHorizon，一个用于长期终端代理的完全自动化数据合成引擎。它从现实世界中的专业工作出发，通过独立执行来识别构建过程中遗漏的关键工作，并利用生成的证据来指导环境重建。为将这些模式扩展到各个阶段，它逐步扩展同一目标下的任务，引入基于先前结果的新要求，并促使进一步探索和改进。使用该引擎，我们构建了1.5K个任务环境，并在生成的数据集上对Qwen3.5-27B进行监督微调，以获得TerminalHorizon-27B。我们在涵盖编码代理任务、现实生产环境中的代理任务以及通用推理的12个基准测试中均实现了显著的性能提升。多个RSI案例研究（每个案例研究有12小时的研发预算）进一步展示了该模型在初始解决方案之外继续实验的能力、根据反馈改进其方法的能力，以及在最终交付成果中保留有效改进的能力。

articles.title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%. These confirm that SOAR significantly improves performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks while effectively mitigating evidence fabrication, fostering more faithful and grounded reasoning with enhanced robustness.
articles.titleCn: 基于源信息的强化学习，用于搜索代理的精确归因
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在搜索代理中的应用常面临证据伪造问题，这是一种代理绕过外部信息（$E_{ext}$）并伪造错误答案的失效模式。我们认为，这种伪造现象源于代理过度依赖不可靠的内部知识（$E_{int}$）作为捷径，这是由于推理轨迹固有的不透明性所致。为解决此问题，我们提出了SOAR（来源感知强化学习），这是一种将整体推理转化为来源明确的轨迹的范式。SOAR（i）通过来源感知工作流将$E_{ext}$和$E_{int}$解耦为并行、可观测的流，以及（ii）引入来源一致的奖励来引导策略进化。通过使信息来源归属明确化，SOAR能够在不同知识流之间实现精确的归因。评估显示，SOAR在3B和7B主干网络上的表现分别优于基线模型7.3%和5.4%，同时将证据伪造率降低了74.8%。这些结果证实，SOAR显著提升了知识密集型基准测试的性能，同时有效缓解了证据伪造问题，促进了更忠实、更可靠的推理，并增强了鲁棒性。

articles.title: Les Misérables Dialogue: A film-based network representation of social communication
articles.abstract: In this work, we revisit the classic Les Misérables benchmark network from the perspective of social communication. Using the 1998 film adaptation of the novel, we construct the publicly available Les Misérables Dialogue temporal text network, which explicitly distinguishes speakers, addressees, and other recipients of each utterance, along with its content and timing. Using the ten social dimensions model, we also derive multilayer network representations of the network, in which layers correspond to distinct relational dimensions. Beyond the network dataset, this work offers a general methodology for building similarly rich communication datasets from similar narrative sources.
articles.titleCn: 悲惨世界对白：基于电影的社交沟通网络表示
articles.abstractCn: 在这项工作中，我们从社会交流的角度重新审视经典的《悲惨世界》基准网络。利用1998年小说的电影改编版本，我们构建了公开可用的《悲惨世界》对话时间文本网络，该网络明确区分了每个话语的说话人、听话人和其他接收者，以及其内容和时间。我们还使用十维社会模型，从该网络中推导出多层网络表示，其中各层对应不同的关系维度。除了网络数据集之外，这项工作还提供了一种通用方法，用于从类似的叙事来源构建同样丰富的交流数据集。

articles.title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
articles.abstract: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language. The pipeline comprises RoSfera, a 635 GB Romanian corpus containing 175.7 million documents; an 80k byte-level BPE tokenizer; five decoder-only models ranging from 160M to 6B parameters, trained on 131 billion tokens; three instruction-tuned assistants; and two contrastively trained embedding models. Training and evaluation were conducted using computing infrastructure at ELI-NP/IFIN-HH. The model family exhibits consistent scaling of validation loss and increasing Romanian factual and cultural knowledge with model size. On the 1,000-question WWTBM benchmark, Neurograf-6B achieves 69.89% accuracy on Romanian-context questions, while Neurograf-3.2B reaches 67.38%. Compute-optimal analysis yields a parameter-scaling exponent of approximately 0.423. Neurograf v1 serves as an experimental demonstrator rather than a production system. The study identifies practical challenges involving diacritic preservation, corpus quality, data composition, and tokenization efficiency, while demonstrating the feasibility of developing Romanian-first base models, instruction-following assistants, and semantic embedding models within a unified training pipeline.
articles.titleCn: Neurograf v1：一个以罗马尼亚语为首要语言的一站式语言模型家族
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Neurograf v1，这是一个实验性的端到端罗马尼亚第一语言模型管道，旨在研究为低资源欧洲语言从头训练语言模型的可行性。该管道包括RoSfera，一个包含1.757亿份文档的635 GB罗马尼亚语语料库；一个80k字节级别的BPE分词器；五个参数量从1.6亿到60亿的解码器模型，在1310亿个token上进行训练；三个指令微调的助手；以及两个对比训练的嵌入模型。训练和评估使用ELI-NP/IFIN-HH的计算基础设施进行。该模型系列表现出验证损失的持续缩放，以及随着模型规模增加，罗马尼亚事实和文化知识的提升。在1,000个问题的WWTBM基准测试中，Neurograf-6B在罗马尼亚语境问题上的准确率达到69.89%，而Neurograf-3.2B达到67.38%。计算最优分析得出参数缩放指数约为0.423。Neurograf v1是一个实验性演示器，而非生产系统。该研究识别了涉及变音符号保留、语料库质量、数据组成和分词效率的实际挑战，同时展示了在统一训练管道中开发罗马尼亚第一基础模型、指令跟随助手和语义嵌入模型的可行性。

articles.title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
articles.abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
