articles.titleCn: 定位、判断、阅读：面向开放域多模态文档问答的知识点索引的专角色工具代理
articles.abstractCn: 在处理大型异构文档集合的问答任务中，首先需要找到正确的段落，然后阅读这些段落，然而当前的检索增强型代理同时赋予模型这两种工具，并允许其自行调度。我们提出了KnowForge，一个按任务划分的流程：一个混合检索的知识点索引；一个只能搜索的定位代理；一个强制执行缺失的第二跳的代码调度桥梁裁判；一个类型化、大小受限的证据池，它合并了每次搜索的排名；一个只能读取文本、图像和表格的深度阅读代理；以及一个带有格式检查器的合成器。使用自托管的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B主动），KnowForge在完整的开放域M3DocVQA（2,441个问题，3,368份PDF）上达到了F1 47.5，比已发布的M3DocRAG系统高11.0，比在同一索引和模型上的一跳检索回答高7.1，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash时达到53.5。在MultiHop-RAG上，它达到了73.5的准确率，超过了最强的已发布的RAG和GraphRAG结果（71.2）；在单文档MMLongBench-Doc上，它将同一模型的分数从34.8提升到47.0，与GPT-4o读取页面图像的水平相当（46.3）。在完整基准测试上的每项任务消融实验将增益归因于：深度阅读在三个语料库上分别贡献了3.8、9.8和0分，反映了其视觉依赖程度；将两个代理合并为一个拥有所有工具并执行两倍轮次的模型会因持续搜索而非阅读而损失1.9 F1；轮次预算扫描显示在四个定位轮次处有一个步骤，之后达到平台期；查询延迟随模型调用次数而非语料库大小而变化。我们将三个索引基准测试作为只读知识库提供（免费注册），并发布所有提示和运行代码：https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

articles.title: BenCoDiC: A Large-Scale Contextual Cyberbullying Corpus for Bengali Political News Discourse FULL VERSION
articles.abstract: Cyberbullying is a growing concern in online communities, yet existing Bengali corpora remain limited in contextual information, annotation transparency, scale, accessibility, and support for multidimensional analysis, thereby hindering robust detection and comprehensive study of harasser behaviors and networks. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (\textit{BenCoDiC}) corpus, a publicly available contextual cyberbullying resource for Bengali political news discourse comprising 50,250 textual instances collected from 100 YouTube videos and their associated discussions. The corpus preserves caption--comment--reply relationships and is organized through a nine-dimensional star schema covering users, videos, textual content, context, time, engagement, political parties, target identities, and language categories. Five AI chatbots were initially evaluated for annotation but did not meet the predefined reliability criterion. Consequently, a two-tier human annotation process with expert verification was adopted, achieving Fleiss' $κ=0.86$ and Krippendorff's $α=0.86$. Statistical analyses characterize the corpus, while transformer-based experiments show that incorporating conversational context yields modest but consistent improvements over isolated-text classification. \textit{BenCoDiC} supports context-aware cyberbullying detection and perpetrator-oriented behavioral and network analysis. The corpus is available at https://github.com/bencodic/BenCoDiC-Corpus.
articles.titleCn: BenCoDiC：面向孟加拉语政治新闻话语的大规模情境网络欺凌语料库完整版
articles.abstractCn: 网络欺凌是网络社区日益关注的问题，然而现有的孟加拉语语料库在语境信息、标注透明度、规模、可访问性和多维分析支持方面仍然有限，这阻碍了对欺凌行为和网络的稳健检测和全面研究。为解决这些差距，我们介绍了孟加拉语语境和多样化网络欺凌（\textit{BenCoDiC}）语料库，这是一个公开可用的语境化网络欺凌资源，包含孟加拉语政治新闻话语中的50,250个文本实例，这些实例收集自100个YouTube视频及其相关讨论。该语料库保留了标题-评论-回复关系，并通过一个涵盖用户、视频、文本内容、语境、时间、参与度、政党、目标身份和语言类别的九维星型模式进行组织。最初评估了五种人工智能聊天机器人用于标注，但它们未达到预定义的可靠性标准。因此，采用了具有专家验证的两层人工标注流程，实现了Fleiss' $κ=0.86$ 和 Krippendorff's $α=0.86$。统计分析描述了该语料库，而基于transformer的实验表明，结合对话语境比孤立文本分类产生了适度但一致的改进。\textit{BenCoDiC}支持语境感知网络欺凌检测和以施暴者为中心的行为和网络分析。该语料库可在 https://github.com/bencodic/BenCoDiC-Corpus 获取。

articles.title: From 2.1M Hours of Raw Broadcast Audio to Finnish Speech SSL: Confidence Filtering and Architectural Analysis at Scale
articles.abstract: Broadcast archives offer scale and diversity for self-supervised learning (SSL) but contain substantial noisy, non-speech, and multilingual content. Prior work typically relies on voice activity detection or language identification (LID) to extract speech, ensuring presence rather than quality. Whether and how to filter unlabeled speech by quality for SSL, particularly from noisy broadcasts, remains underexplored. We present a large-scale Finnish SSL study starting from 2.1M hours of unconstrained broadcast audio. We propose automatic speech recognition (ASR) confidence as a proxy for pretraining data quality and show 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering despite a smaller training set. We further address the lack of controlled architectural comparisons in speech SSL by evaluating Transformer, Macaron-Net, Conformer, and E-Branchformer at matched parameter budgets. Our models improve upon prior Finnish SSL baselines, particularly at Base scale and out-of-domain.
articles.titleCn: 从210万小时原始广播音频到芬兰语音SSL：大规模下的置信度过滤和架构分析
articles.abstractCn: 广播存档为自监督学习（SSL）提供了规模和多样性，但其中包含大量噪声、非语音和多语言内容。以往研究通常依赖语音活动检测或语言识别（LID）来提取语音，确保的是存在性而非质量。如何以及为何要针对SSL过滤未标记语音的质量，尤其是在噪声广播中，仍待深入探索。我们开展了一项大规模芬兰语SSL研究，起始数据为210万小时的 unconstrained 广播音频。我们提出自动语音识别（ASR）置信度作为预训练数据质量的代理指标，并展示相较于基于LID的过滤，尽管训练集规模较小，相对词错误率（WER）仍提升了3-7%。此外，我们通过评估Transformer、Macaron-Net、Conformer和E-Branchformer在匹配参数预算下的表现，弥补了语音SSL中缺乏受控架构比较的空白。我们的模型在先前芬兰语SSL基线基础上有所提升，特别是在Base规模和域外数据集上。

articles.title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
articles.abstract: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.
articles.titleCn: KV-Repurpose：一个用于评估非前缀KV缓存重用的测试平台
articles.abstractCn: 在大语言模型服务中，KV缓存重用通常仅限于精确的提示前缀，导致在相同检索到的文档出现在不同的系统提示、对话历史或动态元数据之后时无法重用。我们提出了KV-Repurpose，这是一个基于vLLM的开源系统，用于开发和评估超出精确前缀的片段级KV缓存重用。该系统结合了缓存感知的片段调度、提示构建、容量管理、工作负载生成和运行时监控。在长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，简单的片段重用对于单文档问答和摘要能够很大程度上保持输出质量，但在跨文档推理方面暴露出明显的局限性。在20%的请求共享固定前缀的Zipfian RAG风格工作负载下，KV-Repurpose在相同的30 GB缓存容量下，比前缀缓存实现了显著更高的token级缓存命中率，分别为63.9%和3.3%，从而降低了TTFT。即使有1 TB的缓存容量，前缀缓存在此工作负载下的命中率也只有17.9%。源代码可在Apache-2.0许可证下获取，地址为https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose。

articles.title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
articles.abstract: Radiology reports are essential for diagnostic reasoning and patient care, yet their manual preparation is time-consuming and cognitively demanding. Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) offers a scalable alternative, but existing models often produce lengthy, unstructured narratives that overlook diagnostic cues and multi-view information. We present Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation (CliQ-RRG), a unified two-stage framework for interpretable and clinically grounded reporting. In Stage 1, CliQ-RRG employs a Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment module that aligns image and text representations using predicted disease embeddings, reinforced by a Prior-Guided Attention Module (PrAM) to capture multi-view dependencies across current and prior scans. In Stage 2, GraphRAG-guided retrieval augments intermediate textual representations with graph-grounded clinical evidence, and a large language model restructures them into concise, interpretable question-answer (QA) pairs with diagnostic summaries. Experiments on two public chest X-ray benchmarks demonstrate that CliQ-RRG consistently outperforms prior methods across both lexical and clinical metrics, generating accurate and clinically coherent QA-style radiology reports. Code is available at: https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/CliQ-RRG.
articles.titleCn: CliQ-RRG：临床知识引导的疾病感知视觉-文本对齐，用于问答式放射报告生成
articles.abstractCn: 放射科报告对于诊断推理和患者护理至关重要，但其手动编制既耗时又需要认知投入。自动放射科报告生成（RRG）提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但现有模型常生成冗长、非结构化的叙述，忽略了诊断线索和多视角信息。我们提出了临床知识引导的疾病感知视觉-文本对齐的问答式放射科报告生成（CliQ-RRG），这是一个用于可解释且基于临床报告的统一两阶段框架。在第一阶段，CliQ-RRG采用疾病感知视觉-文本对齐模块，利用预测的疾病嵌入对齐图像和文本表示，并通过先验引导注意力模块（PrAM）强化，以捕获当前和既往扫描之间的多视角依赖关系。在第二阶段，GraphRAG引导检索通过图基础的临床证据增强中间文本表示，然后大型语言模型将其重构为简洁、可解释的问答（QA）对，并附有诊断摘要。在两个公共胸部X光基准数据集上的实验表明，CliQ-RRG在词汇和临床指标上均持续优于先前方法，生成了准确且临床连贯的问答式放射科报告。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/CliQ-RRG。

articles.title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.
articles.titleCn: 回溯以前进：长时程智能体的回顾探索与演进
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地运行在长时程环境中，其中早期的错误可能引发级联故障，并将代理困在死胡同轨迹中。因此，代理必须能够主动从这种状态中恢复，并将探索经验转化为后续决策的指导。我们介绍了ReTRAIL，一个使代理能够将环境回退到先前状态，同时保留有效进展并继续推进从放弃的探索中学习到的知识的框架。环境状态向后移动，而代理的知识继续向前移动。ReTRAIL使用两个互补信号训练一个共享策略：状态锚定GRPO将比较从重新访问的状态中选择的替代延续来改进执行，而分支推进奖励则通过后续探索的进展引导反思。在MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld四个交互式基准测试中的实验表明，仅仅添加回退原语提供的收益有限，甚至可能降低性能。相比之下，ReTRAIL使代理能够从无生产力的状态中回退，并利用从放弃的分支中获得的见解来指导后续探索。这些结果表明，在长时程任务解决中，将环境回退与任务中经验重用相结合具有价值。代码可在https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL获取。

articles.title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
articles.abstract: Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.

articles.titleCn: CoBe：对话反事实文本编辑基准
articles.abstractCn: 反事实文本编辑是指根据一个假设性改变来修订给定文本，同时保留不受该改变因果影响的事实。当被问及如果医生没有建议手术会发生什么时，模型输出应保留患者的病史，仅修改决策的后果。这需要因果理解：模型必须在不明确指示的情况下，确定哪些事件受到假设性改变的影响，哪些应保持固定。这项技能对于人类推理至关重要，尤其是在医疗保健或法律等安全关键领域。相比之下，关联文本生成的任务仅仅是生成与改变条件统计相关的文本。在医疗示例中，关联性响应可能会使患者的症状减轻，因为较轻的病例与未手术相关。此类响应会产生一个看似合理的场景，但不是给定场景的反事实版本。先前的反事实文本数据集未能清晰地区分这些推理模式。我们介绍了反事实基准（CoBe），这是一个用于测试模型在对话自然方式下被提示时，零样本反事实编辑给定文本场景能力的测试平台。CoBe包含涵盖医疗保健、科学和工程、商业和日常场景的2000个问题。我们测试了一系列前沿和小型模型，其中前沿系统平均得分为58.05%。我们的研究表明，模型经常默认采用关联性生成，而不是保留原始场景的因果结构。此外，性能并不始终与模型大小或输出标记长度成比例增长，这表明该问题可能反映模型训练目标，而非模型能力不足。

articles.title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
articles.abstract: Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. Matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction, showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. Based on this insight, we introduce RAMP (Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision), which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. Across context lengths up to 4K, RAMP preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100, corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.
articles.titleCn: RAMP：循环自适应混合精度技术，用于提升循环深度语言模型的预填充效率
articles.abstractCn: 循环深度语言模型通过反复应用共享网络来优化推理时的内部表征，但额外的循环计算也增加了推理成本。这种开销在长上下文预填充阶段尤为明显，此时整个输入序列在循环深度中被反复处理。权重与激活量化提供了一种通过低精度算术加速计算的自然方式，但反复应用量化计算会引入数值扰动，这些扰动沿着循环轨迹累积。我们系统地分析了此类误差如何在循环深度中传播，并证明早期引入的量化误差会被后续更多的循环步骤所衰减，因此对最终表征的影响较小。匹配预算实验有力地支持了这一预测，表明将量化计算置于循环深度的早期阶段始终能获得最佳保真度。基于这一见解，我们提出了RAMP（循环自适应混合精度）方法，该方法使用低精度权重与激活计算进行早期的循环优化，并在终端优化阶段恢复高精度。在高达4K的上下文长度范围内，RAMP在保持近乎全精度预填充质量的同时，在NVIDIA H100上实现了高达1.16倍的端到端首次预填充加速，相当于13.9%的延迟降低。

articles.title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
articles.abstract: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.
articles.titleCn: GeoGR：空间语义标记压缩和组路由，用于高效3D视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 多视图表征使预训练的图像和视频视觉语言模型能够理解三维场景，但它们的长视觉标记序列使得推理成本高昂。冗余既源于跨视图对相同场景区域的重复观察，也源于在每一层LLM中对所有视觉标记的处理，而不管它们与当前计算的相关性如何。我们提出了GeoGR，一个两阶段框架，它联合压缩场景表征和视觉计算。在投影器层面，GeoSemZip将跨视图观察整合为三维体素标记，并结合语义显著性与空间覆盖来构建紧凑的场景表征。未选择的体素特征被聚合为上下文锚点，以保留原本将被丢弃的场景信息。在LLM层面，我们识别出一个有效的视觉计算窗口，并观察到查询条件下的标记相关性在局部保持稳定，但在较长的层间隔内发生变化。根据这些发现，GroupRoute结合了后期进入和早期退出，以及可恢复的分组跳过。低相关性的标记可以绕过完整的LLM层，同时保留其隐藏状态，并在后续锚点层重新加入活跃组，这些锚点层是在计算预算下选择的。对于压缩感知的后训练，我们通过保留原始训练池的30%来构建一个包含6.7K样本的紧凑数据集。通过该协议，GeoGR在LLaVA-OneVision-7B和Video-3D LLM-7B上分别保留了95.2%和96.8%的密集后训练模型的性能，同时将LLM预填充加速了6.8倍和6.1倍。这些结果表明GeoGR在有无显式三维空间编码的三维VLM中始终有效，突显了其良好的性能效率权衡。代码可在https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR获取。

articles.title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
articles.abstract: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both the Proposer and the Reflector. We further develop EvoTIDE, a training pipeline that recovers usable trajectories through edit extraction and prefix continuation, then combines SFT with interleaved GRPO across the two roles. Extensive experiments across three coding benchmarks demonstrate that Evo$^2$ significantly outperforms existing self-evolution methods. It achieves 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest baseline, respectively. We also show that the evolved harnesses transfer to different tasks without further evolution and rank first in cross-benchmark evaluations. Our dual-role harness improvement framework is also able to extend to self-evolution with proprietary models, improving a GPT-5-mini agent's performance from 24.4% to 48.3%. These results demonstrate the applicability of the framework Evo$^2$ across domains and its broad transferability across models and tasks.
articles.titleCn: Evo$^2$：通过权重利用协同进化来进化进化者
articles.abstractCn: 自进化智能体正越来越多地用于通过权重更新或利用改进来提升语言模型系统，而无需人工干预。现有方法通常分别追求这些方向：一些方法使用自生成的经验来更新模型权重，而另一些方法则重写定义智能体如何使用提示、工具、上下文和执行反馈的框架。然而，这些方法忽略了模型权重与智能体框架之间的关系。为了连接这些过程并确保智能体自进化有效且顺畅，我们提出了Evo$^2$，一个用于权重-框架协同进化的框架。对于框架更新，我们设计了一个统一的二元角色管道，单个策略既充当提案者（编写框架修订），又充当反射者（诊断其效果并指导修订）。对于权重更新，框架修改及其执行结果指导提案者和反射者的训练。我们进一步开发了EvoTIDE，一个通过编辑提取和前缀延续来恢复可用轨迹的训练管道，然后将SFT与跨两个角色的交错GRPO相结合。在三个编程基准上的大量实验表明，Evo$^2$显著优于现有的自进化方法。它在Polyglot上达到82.1%，在SWE-bench Verified上达到48.3%，而最强基线的相应得分分别为62.6%和41.0%。我们还展示了进化后的框架可以无缝迁移到不同任务而无需进一步进化，并在跨基准评估中排名第一。我们的二元角色框架改进方法也能够扩展到专有模型的自我进化，将GPT-5-mini智能体的性能从24.4%提升到48.3%。这些结果表明，框架Evo$^2$适用于各个领域，并在模型和任务之间具有广泛的迁移能力。

articles.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
articles.abstract: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.
articles.titleCn: EmbodiedCLBench：评估自我进化型具身智能体的持续学习能力
articles.abstractCn: 持续学习要求模型积累过去的经验并将其迁移到新任务中。尽管持续学习领域已有大量研究，但现有工作仍主要局限于非具身环境，尚未扩展到具身环境。为填补这一空白，我们引入了EmbodiedCLBench，这是具身仿真领域首个用于评估自进化智能体持续学习能力的基础评测。以组合泛化为核心评测原则，我们的评测基准评估智能体是否能够先从基础任务中学习，然后重新组合所学技能来解决复杂且未见的高级任务。基于EmbodiedCLBench，我们在多种智能体框架和学习方法上进行了广泛的实验，揭示了普遍存在的局限性和独特的表现。结果表明，在零样本设置下高级任务难以解决，但基础任务的经验能够实现持续改进。这种由经验带来的优势即使任务复杂度增加时也保持稳定。然而，这种改进并不随学习样本数量的增加而相应提升，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有意义的信息。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明持续学习是一项基础但尚未充分探索的能力，而我们的评测基准为设计具身环境中的有效自进化智能体提供了宝贵资源。我们的代码和数据集可在https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage获取。

articles.title: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance
articles.abstract: Creativity benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) vary widely in task and metric design. This raises the question of whether they capture a common notion of creativity. We propose that this shared target can be formalized as task-specific performance in the long tail of a reference input-output distribution, which describes how common input-output pairs are relative to a chosen source of text. We ground this proposition in the novelty-quality product formulation and evaluate it empirically across 15 benchmarks and 26 open-weight models, using n-gram absence from the pretraining data as a novelty proxy. Our results show that creativity benchmarks lie further in the tail regions than standard benchmarks. Moreover, on both creativity and standard benchmarks, model rankings from higher-tail subsets of each benchmark align more closely with human creativity judgments in LM-Arena. Building on these findings, we introduce q@Tail($α$), a lower-cost creativity diagnostic that measures mean task quality on the tail fraction of an existing benchmark. Applying it to creativity-promoting methods reveals substantial room to improve LLM creativity through stronger tail performance.
articles.comment: 26 pages, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/YichenZW/longtail-creativity
articles.titleCn: 通过长尾性能评估大型语言模型的创造力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在任务和指标设计上的创造力基准差异很大，这引发了它们是否能够捕捉到共同创造力概念的问题。我们提出，这一共同目标可以形式化为参考输入输出分布的长尾中的特定任务性能，该分布描述了相对于所选文本来源的常见输入输出对。我们将这一命题建立在新颖性-质量乘积公式的基础上，并通过使用预训练数据中的n-gram缺失作为新颖性代理，在15个基准和26个开放权重模型上进行了实证评估。我们的结果表明，创造力基准位于比标准基准更远的尾部区域。此外，在创造力和标准基准上，每个基准的高尾部子集的模型排名与LM-Arena中的人类创造力判断更加一致。基于这些发现，我们引入了q@Tail($α$)，这是一种低成本创造力诊断方法，它测量现有基准尾部分数上的平均任务质量。将其应用于促进创造力的方法表明，通过更强的尾部性能，有大量空间可以提升LLM的创造力。

articles.title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
articles.abstract: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. In a study of 10 technology domains (50,000 more patents), we find that a domain's classification breadth--the number of distinct CPC subgroups spanned--predicts approach performance (Pearson r=-0.642, p=0.045, N=10), and that patents per subgroup is an even stronger predictor (r=0.715, p=0.020). This provides a checkable signal for practitioners to determine where the method is most valuable. We report all findings with statistical transparency and release a complete, 91-test automated implementation.
articles.titleCn: 针对无监督专利权利要求分类，对嵌入几何形状和聚类算法进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 现有技术检索系统通常围绕分类代码进行结构化组织，这使得跨代码发现变得困难。本文探讨了基于专利文本的无监督表征是否能够恢复代码限制性搜索无法发现的关联性，以及双曲空间是否有助于此过程。我们在45,000项美国专利（96次运行，6个种子）上训练了双曲和匹配的欧几里得变分自编码器（VAE）。双曲模型比欧几里得模型更频繁地检索到真正跨类别的现有技术（在排名前10的结果中，3000次查询，双曲模型为18.76%，欧几里得模型为12.34%，提高了52%），这对推动搜索问题具有实际意义。双曲模型与官方分类的吻合度较低（NMI为0.2392对比0.3206），我们通过几何学解释了这一点：这两种度量标准捕捉了不同的目标，只有其中一种与现有技术搜索需求相一致。在一个涵盖10个技术领域（额外50,000项专利）的研究中，我们发现一个领域的分类广度——即所涵盖的不同CPC子组的数量——可以预测方法性能（Pearson r=-0.642，p=0.045，N=10），而每个子组中的专利数量则是一个更强的预测指标（r=0.715，p=0.020）。这为从业者提供了一个可验证的信号，以确定该方法最具价值的领域。我们以统计透明度报告所有发现，并发布了一个完整的、包含91项测试的自动化实现。

articles.title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) remains a widely used approach for post-training large language models, because fixed demonstrations can directly introduce desired reasoning strategies and behavioral patterns. Yet forcing a model to imitate externally provided trajectories may also interfere with behaviors already supported by pretraining, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. Recent dynamic SFT methods mitigate this issue by reweighting token-level supervision according to model-side signals such as predictive probability, prior support, or distributional compatibility. However, model compatibility is not equivalent to learning value: a token that is weakly supported by the current model may either be an undesirable mismatch or precisely the task-specific decision that the demonstration is intended to teach. We propose CIG-SFT, an information-theoretic framework that estimates the task-conditioned information carried by each demonstrated token. Under teacher forcing, we compare the token likelihood from a frozen reference model with and without access to the task input while keeping the gold solution prefix fixed. The resulting conditional information gain quantifies how much the task itself reduces uncertainty about the demonstrated decision. We then convert this information into a KL-regularized projection of the current policy and derive an equivalent scalar-weighted SFT objective whose logit gradient exactly matches that of the projected target. Across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, CIG-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT and recent adaptive fine-tuning baselines, with particularly strong improvements in generalization to challenging evaluation distributions, while requiring neither additional training data nor online rollouts.
articles.titleCn: SFT应该学习什么？通用训练后条件信息增益
articles.abstractCn: 监督微调（SFT）仍然是训练后大型语言模型的一种广泛采用的方法，因为固定的示例可以直接引入所需的推理策略和行为模式。然而，强制模型模仿外部提供的轨迹也可能干扰预训练已支持的行为，从而限制模型在训练分布之外的泛化能力。最近的动态SFT方法通过根据模型端信号（如预测概率、先验支持或分布兼容性）重新加权标记级监督来缓解这个问题。然而，模型兼容性并不等同于学习价值：当前模型支持程度较弱的标记可能是令人不快的错配，也可能是示例旨在教授的任务特定决策。我们提出了CIG-SFT，这是一个基于信息论框架，用于估计每个示例标记所携带的任务条件信息。在教师强制下，我们比较了在固定参考模型中，有和没有任务输入访问时，固定黄金解决方案前缀的标记似然。由此产生的条件信息增益量化了任务本身如何减少对示例决策的不确定性。然后我们将这些信息转换为KL正则化的当前策略投影，并推导出一个等效的标量加权SFT目标，其logit梯度与投影目标完全匹配。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，CIG-SFT始终优于标准SFT和最近的自适应微调基线，在泛化到具有挑战性的评估分布方面取得了特别显著的改进，同时既不需要额外的训练数据，也不需要在线回滚。

articles.title: Language Models Have Interpretable Narrative Mechanisms
articles.abstract: We investigate whether language models contain internal components that contribute to representing narrativity, the degree to which a text exhibits narrative properties. Across GPT-2-Small, Gemma-2-2B, and Llama-3.1-8B, we identify attention heads, MLP neurons, and sparse autoencoder features whose activations correlate with narrativity. Ablating selected neuron and feature sets increases next-token prediction loss more for high-narrativity than for low-narrativity texts, and reduces the narrativity of open-ended generations. On downstream benchmarks, the largest effects occur in story completion and narrative question answering, although they vary across models and languages; results on confabulation and hallucination benchmarks are mixed. These findings provide causal evidence that selected sets of narrative-associated components contribute to model behaviour, while their internal organisation, relation to narrative theory, and broader functions remain open questions.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型具有可解释的叙事机制
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了语言模型是否包含有助于表征叙事性的内部组件，即文本展现叙事特性的程度。在GPT-2-Small、Gemma-2-2B和Llama-3.1-8B中，我们识别出与叙事性相关的注意力头、MLP神经元和稀疏自动编码器特征，其激活与叙事性相关。移除选定的神经元和特征集会增加高叙事性文本的下一个词预测损失，并降低开放式生成的叙事性。在下游基准测试中，故事完成和叙事问答的效果最为显著，尽管它们在不同模型和语言中的表现有所不同；在虚构和幻觉基准测试中的结果则较为复杂。这些发现提供了因果证据，表明选定的叙事相关组件有助于模型行为，而它们的内部组织、与叙事理论的关系以及更广泛的功能仍为开放性问题。

articles.title: Forecasting Corpus-Sampling Disagreement in Masked Text Reconstruction
articles.abstract: If a second text corpus were collected from the same population, how much would a predictor's outputs change? We study this question for masked-text reconstruction using a smoothed predictor built from nearby token-pair counts and evaluated over the full 50,257-token GPT-2 vocabulary. Treating each source document as one observation, we derive a first-order formula for the expected disagreement between predictors fitted to two independent corpora. The formula accounts for variable document length, random context counts, and correlations across token offsets, and it can be evaluated from a separate reference corpus without access to either target corpus. On TinyStories, WikiText-103, and CNN/DailyMail, growing each corpus from 512 to 2,048 chunks of 64 tokens lowers disagreement by only 5--40\%, far short of the 75\% implied by $1/n$ scaling. The forecast tracks this slow decline, which we trace to smoothing of rarely seen contexts. Forecast accuracy depends less on how these correlations are modeled than on the size of the reference corpus: small references systematically underpredict disagreement. A source-split jackknife that uses only reference data reduces this calibration error by 57--59\%. After this correction, a simpler smoothed-multinomial approximation is most accurate when the reference corpus is smaller than the target corpus, and a nonlinear source bootstrap is most accurate when it is larger. Finally, small masked diffusion language models trained on the same corpora show that the count-based forecasts partly identify which inputs are most sensitive to the corpus, but miss the neural models' much faster decline in disagreement.
articles.titleCn: 预测掩码文本重建中的语料库采样分歧
articles.abstractCn: 如果从同一人群收集第二个文本语料库，预测器的输出会发生多大变化？我们针对掩码文本重建问题研究了这个问题，使用从邻近词对计数构建的平滑预测器，并在完整的50,257个词的GPT-2词汇表上进行评估。将每个源文档视为一个观测值，我们推导出两个独立语料库上拟合的预测器之间预期不一致性的第一阶公式。该公式考虑了文档长度的变化、随机上下文计数以及词偏移量之间的相关性，并且可以在不访问任何目标语料库的情况下从参考语料库中评估。在TinyStories、WikiText-103和CNN/DailyMail上，将每个语料库从512个64词的块增长到2,048个块，仅降低了5--40%的不一致性，远低于1/n缩放所暗示的75%。预测跟踪了这种缓慢下降，我们将其归因于罕见上下文的平滑处理。预测精度取决于如何对这些相关性进行建模，而不是参考语料库的大小：小参考语料库系统地低估了不一致性。一个仅使用参考数据的源拆分刀切法将这种校准误差降低了57--59%。在此校正后，当参考语料库小于目标语料库时，简单的平滑多项式近似最为准确，而当参考语料库较大时，非线性源引导最为准确。最后，在相同语料库上训练的小型掩码扩散语言模型表明，基于计数的预测部分识别了哪些输入对语料库最敏感，但遗漏了神经模型的不一致性下降速度要快得多。

articles.title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
articles.abstract: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, \k{appa} = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).
articles.titleCn: 智能销售平台：一个考虑抗干扰性的多轮基准，用于评估大型语言模型销售代理
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了SmartSalesBench，这是首个专门设计用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）销售代理在面对基于心理学、具有抵触性的买家角色时的多轮对话能力的基准。现有的任务导向型对话基准假设用户具有合作性，并衡量任务完成度；而SmartSalesBench则颠覆了这一假设，将代理置于被编程为在长达二十轮的对话中持续抵触和挑战的角色之间。该基准包含五个代理配置文件、十二个买家角色、六个价格等级的十五款智能手机产品，以及四个受控实验（共3次迭代，总计13,680场会话）。代理和买家角色的生成均通过检索增强生成（RAG）实现。我们引入了九项评估指标，分为三个层级：主要结果指标（CR、BRS、RIR）、次要质量指标（SMS、PFS、ETI）以及计划用于未来报告的探索性指标（ITS、ARI、SPI）。我们的评估结合了自动化的LLM作为评判者的评分和内部人工评估（n = 50, \kappa = 0.71, 与BRS的Pearson r = 0.81）。

articles.title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
articles.abstract: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process. Across 15 LVLMs, we reveal the difficulty of multi-graph reasoning and identify cross-view edge alignment and relation-level composition as prominent bottlenecks through stage-oriented diagnostics. Meanwhile, temporal constraints and increasing view counts expose further capability boundaries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph.
articles.titleCn: MVGraph：在多视图视觉图证据组合上对LVLMs进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了MVGraph，一个用于评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多图推理上的基准，其中查询所需的证据分布在多个相互关联的视觉图视图中。尽管这种证据通常存在于特定来源的图、时间快照或局部观察中，但现有的图推理基准仍然局限于单一的自包含结构，仅评估图感知和推理，而未充分探索跨视图的证据对齐和组合。MVGraph包含8k个实例，涵盖8个图论任务，从两个多图场景（部分图视图和时间图视图）中抽象而来。每个问题都是通过程序构建并验证为无法从单一视图中解决的。除了端到端评估外，我们将多图推理分解为四个互补能力——感知、对齐、组合和推理——并设计了29个诊断任务，包含64k个实例，用于探测每一个能力，并提供黄金中间表示来评估中间过程。通过对15个LVLMs的分析，我们揭示了多图推理的难度，并通过阶段导向诊断识别出跨视图边对齐和关系级组合是突出的瓶颈。同时，时间约束和不断增加的视图数量暴露了进一步的能力边界。代码和数据可在https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph获取。

articles.title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. Motivated by these findings, we propose entropy and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor hidden-state sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant. As part of this framework, we introduce token-entropy filtering, which removes hidden states associated with low predictive-entropy tokens, thereby improving the quality of layer-selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, our selected sets outperform fixed baseline choices, including the default $[2, N//2, N-3]$ rule, while providing a clearer explanation of why some defaults can remain competitive. Our results provide a practical recipe for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding, insights into the geometry and information in LLM decoder states, and a foundation for extending similar analysis to related applications.

articles.titleCn: 驾驭激活浪潮：分析LLM隐藏状态的信息与几何结构以进行推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）不同层级的解码器隐藏状态通常编码互补信息。然而，现有的推测解码方法通常依赖于固定、基于位置启发式选择的一小组目标模型层。选择最优层级子集本质上是一个组合问题，即使对于中等深度的模型，穷尽性评估也难以实现。在这项工作中，我们基于两个互补标准——信息量（通过矩阵熵分析衡量）和多样性（使用中心核对齐（CKA）量化）——提出了一种基于多层级隐藏状态选择的原则性框架，用于推测解码。我们研究了逐层的香农熵、隐藏状态拼接下的总熵以及深度内的成对CKA动态，揭示了解码器表示中的不同几何和信息隔间。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了基于熵和CKA的层级选择算法，优先选择信息量高且冗余度最小的隐藏状态集。作为该框架的一部分，我们引入了标记熵过滤，通过移除与低预测熵标记相关联的隐藏状态，从而提高层级选择统计的质量。在EAGLE3风格的推测解码中，我们选择的状态集优于固定的基线选择，包括默认的$[2, N//2, N-3]$规则，同时提供了更清晰的解释，说明为什么某些默认选择可以保持竞争力。我们的结果为推测解码的多层级隐藏状态选择提供了一种实用方法，揭示了LLM解码器状态中的几何和信息，并为将类似分析扩展到相关应用奠定了基础。

articles.title: SEEDS: Preview-Guided Evidence Admission for Search Agents
articles.abstract: Search agents extend large reasoning models with multi-round access to external knowledge, yet most existing systems largely conflate retrieving evidence with consuming it. Retrieved documents are commonly incorporated according to fixed or rank-based policies, despite the fact that evidence utility is conditioned on the agent's current reasoning state. Consequently, a lower-ranked candidate may be critical for the current step, while a higher-ranked candidate may provide redundant, irrelevant, or misleading information. We formulate this overlooked problem as evidence admission, which asks, at each search step, which retrieved candidates should be allowed to enter the agent's evolving reasoning context. To enable such selective control, we introduce SEEDS (Selective Evidence Entry During Search), a preview-guided evidence admission framework for search agents. SEEDS first exposes lightweight previews of retrieved candidates and then lets the agent jointly determine which candidates and how many should be fully inspected, conditioned on its current reasoning state. Unlike fixed or adaptive prefix policies, SEEDS can select arbitrary subsets with flexible cardinality, and it can be instantiated directly with an existing reasoning agent or further optimized through learning. Across nine knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks under both local corpus and live web search, SEEDS consistently improves search effectiveness while substantially reducing full-evidence consumption. Experimental analyses show that SEEDS more effectively selects useful candidates beyond the corresponding retrieval prefix. These results establish evidence admission as a complementary dimension of agentic search, separating what information is retrieved from what information is ultimately allowed to shape reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 种子：预览引导的证据准入，用于搜索代理
articles.abstractCn: 搜索代理通过多轮访问外部知识扩展了大型推理模型，但大多数现有系统在很大程度上混淆了检索证据与消费证据。尽管证据效用取决于代理当前的推理状态，但检索到的文档通常根据固定或基于排名的策略进行整合。因此，一个排名较低的候选可能对当前步骤至关重要，而一个排名较高的候选可能提供冗余、不相关或误导性信息。我们将这个问题表述为证据准入，它要求在每一步搜索中，哪些检索到的候选应该被允许进入代理不断发展的推理环境。为了实现这种选择性控制，我们引入了SEEDS（搜索期间选择性证据进入），这是一个基于预览的证据准入框架。SEEDS首先向代理展示检索到的候选的轻量级预览，然后让代理根据其当前的推理状态共同确定哪些候选以及多少候选应该被完全检查。与固定或自适应前缀策略不同，SEEDS可以选择任意子集，其基数灵活，并且可以直接与现有的推理代理实例化，或通过学习进一步优化。在九个知识密集型问答基准测试中，无论是在本地语料库还是在实时网络搜索下，SEEDS始终在显著减少完整证据消费的同时提高了搜索效果。实验分析表明，SEEDS在相应的检索前缀之外更有效地选择了有用的候选。这些结果将证据准入确立为代理搜索的一个补充维度，将检索到的信息与最终允许塑造推理的信息分离开来。

articles.title: Rethinking the Roles of Diffusion and Decoding: Predictive-State Flows for Parallel Language Generation
articles.abstract: In continuous diffusion language models (DLMs), latents generated by the diffusion prior are mapped almost deterministically to tokens, either by a decoder or through a token embedding matrix. Unlike in image generation, where visual details can vary continuously, the diffusion prior must capture fine-grained discrete token choices in continuous space, which can make the joint latent distribution difficult to model. We argue that generative roles should instead be divided: the diffusion prior should generate high-level predictive information, while the decoder should resolve the remaining token-level choices. Based on this view, we introduce Predictive-State Flows (PSF), which partitions a sequence into blocks and associates each block with a predictive state computed solely from the preceding context. A rectified-flow prior generates the sequence of predictive states, after which a block-causal decoder generates all blocks in parallel, autoregressively only within each block. This design reduces diffusion from L token-level states to K << L predictive states and reduces token-level sequential depth to L/K. On unconditional OpenWebText generation, a 197M-parameter model with K=8 achieves a generative perplexity of 22.8 at entropy 5.16 using 0.31 TFLOPs per 1024-token document, versus 24.0 and 7.2 TFLOPs for ELF-B with 32 sampling steps. The corresponding measured operating points yield MAUVE@512 of 0.93 and 0.73, respectively. Controlled comparisons further show that content states, which additionally encode their own blocks, yield 8-16% higher generative perplexity than predictive states, and that replacing sampled predictive-state trajectories with a shared mean lowers MAUVE@512 by 0.11. These results suggest that latent design for continuous DLMs should consider not only how compactly text is represented, but also how generative roles are divided between the prior and the decoder.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考扩散和解码的作用：用于并行语言生成的预测状态流
articles.abstractCn: 在连续扩散语言模型（DLMs）中，扩散先验生成的潜在变量几乎确定性地映射到标记，这可以通过解码器或通过标记嵌入矩阵实现。与图像生成不同，在图像生成中视觉细节可以连续变化，扩散先验必须在连续空间中捕捉细粒度的离散标记选择，这使得联合潜在分布难以建模。我们认为生成角色应该重新分配：扩散先验应生成高级预测信息，而解码器应解决剩余的标记级选择。基于这一观点，我们引入了预测状态流（PSF），它将序列划分为块，并将每个块与仅从先前上下文中计算的预测状态相关联。一个整流流先验生成预测状态序列，然后一个块因果解码器并行生成所有块，仅在块内部自回归。这种设计将扩散从L个标记级状态减少到K << L个预测状态，并将标记级序列深度减少到L/K。在无条件OpenWebText生成中，一个197M参数模型（K=8）在熵为5.16时，使用每个1024标记文档0.31 TFLOPs，实现了22.8的生成困惑度，而ELF-B需要32个采样步骤，分别达到24.0困惑度和7.2 TFLOPs。相应的测量工作点分别产生0.93和0.73的MAUVE@512。受控比较进一步表明，内容状态（额外编码它们自己的块）比预测状态产生8-16%更高的生成困惑度，并且用共享均值替换采样的预测状态轨迹将MAUVE@512降低0.11。这些结果表明，连续DLMs的潜在设计不仅要考虑文本如何紧凑表示，还要考虑生成角色如何在先验和解码器之间分配。

articles.title: Temporal Evidence Forests for Long-Horizon Multi-Party Conversational Memory
articles.abstract: Long-term memory has been widely adopted in LLM-based agents to support persistent interaction and personalized assistance. Long-term multi-party interactions, however, accumulate substantially more detailed information, with decisions repeatedly updated and states evolving across participants and interaction stages. Temporal structure is therefore crucial for tracing such memories: relevant information often appears densely within short intervals, while transitions among different states are anchored by a strict temporal order. Existing temporally aware memory frameworks primarily store time as metadata or use temporal signals to guide retrieval over preconstructed memory structures, without using temporal structure to both recover locally concentrated evidence and reconstruct its complete event progression. To address these limitations, we propose T-Mem, a temporal-structure-based memory framework that preserves interactions and organizes query-relevant evidence through two temporal mechanisms. Temporal Evidence Discovery exploits the local concentration of related messages to recover overlooked evidence, while Temporal Memory Structuring models state transitions and supporting relations over time and compresses low-information spans within the resulting forest. Evidence Forest Linearization then serializes the structured evidence for answer generation. Experiments on two long-term multi-party memory benchmarks demonstrate that T-Mem consistently outperforms competitive memory frameworks across LLMs, parameter settings, domains, and query types.
articles.titleCn: 长时序多方对话记忆的时序证据森林
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆已被广泛应用于基于大型语言模型的智能体中，以支持持续交互和个性化辅助。然而，长期多方交互会积累大量更详细的信息，决策会反复更新，状态会在参与者和交互阶段之间演变。因此，时间结构对于追踪此类记忆至关重要：相关信息通常在短时间内密集出现，而不同状态之间的转换则由严格的时间顺序锚定。现有的时序感知记忆框架主要将时间作为元数据存储，或使用时序信号来指导对预构建记忆结构的检索，而没有利用时间结构来恢复局部集中的证据并重建其完整的事件进程。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了基于时间结构的记忆框架T-Mem，该框架通过两种时间机制来保留交互并组织与查询相关的证据。时序证据发现利用相关消息的局部集中性来恢复被忽视的证据，而时序记忆结构化则在时间上建模状态转换和支持关系，并在生成的森林中压缩低信息跨度。然后，证据森林线性化将结构化证据序列化以生成答案。在两个长期多方记忆基准测试上的实验表明，T-Mem在大型语言模型、参数设置、领域和查询类型方面始终优于竞争性记忆框架。

articles.title: Time Delay System for Sequence Modeling
articles.abstract: Existing sequence models share a critical limitation: they lack an explicit, interpretable mechanism for content-aware temporal recall. LSTMs compress everything into a single hidden state, thereby losing information about specific past events. Transformers attend to all tokens indiscriminately at quadratic cost, while state-space models like Mamba compress history into a fixed-dimensional state without explicit content-addressable memory. To address this gap, we introduce a novel framework grounded in nonlinear time-delay systems, in which the effective delay is dynamically estimated based on the semantic similarity between current and historical inputs. Our approach features three key innovations: (i) a differentiable semantic lag estimator that computes content-aware soft attention weights over history, producing a weighted historical context and similarity score; (ii) a diagonal state space with closed-form cumulative sum solution, achieving O(1) per-step complexity with no sequential loops; and (iii) an interpretable fuzzy semantic modulation mechanism that learns context-dependent rules for balancing instantaneous processing versus historical recall, where rule centers correspond to prototypical semantic contexts. Experimental results on text classification and generation outperform state-of-the-art methods.
articles.titleCn: 序列建模的时间延迟系统
articles.abstractCn: 现有序列模型存在一个关键局限性：它们缺乏一种明确、可解释的内容感知时间回溯机制。LSTM将所有信息压缩到一个隐藏状态中，从而丢失了关于特定过去事件的信息。Transformer以二次成本对所有标记进行无差别注意力，而状态空间模型（如Mamba）将历史信息压缩到固定维度的状态中，却缺乏显式的内容寻址存储。为解决这一缺陷，我们提出了一种基于非线性时延系统的创新框架，其中有效延迟根据当前和历史输入之间的语义相似度动态估计。我们的方法具有三个关键创新点：(i) 可微分的语义延迟估计器，它计算内容感知的软注意力权重，生成加权历史上下文和相似度分数；(ii) 具有闭式累积和解的对角状态空间，实现每步O(1)复杂度且无需顺序循环；(iii) 可解释的模糊语义调制机制，它学习上下文相关的规则以平衡即时处理与历史回溯，其中规则中心对应于典型语义上下文。在文本分类和生成任务上的实验结果优于当前最先进方法。

articles.title: Unreliable Narrator Framing as a Cost-effective Mechanism for Satire Explanation of Australian and American Satirical News
articles.abstract: Satirical news is a unique form of misinformation: it is intended to be humorous by the original publication source but can be misinterpreted. Explanation of satirical news articles is challenging because recent and local context needs to be incorporated. This is a pilot study that explores explanation generation for satirical news articles from Australia and compares them alongside those from USA. The paper demonstrates that framing explanations on unreliable narrator theory on open-weights models can be a feasible, cost-effective alternative to frontier models. We find that models identify the satirical tropes more accurately on the American source than the Australian one. This work results in a novel dataset and an evaluation benchmark for satirical explanation.

articles.titleCn: 不可靠叙述者框架作为讽刺的一种经济高效机制：对澳大利亚和美国讽刺新闻的解释
articles.abstractCn: 讽刺新闻是一种独特的虚假信息形式：其原始发布来源意图使其具有幽默性，但可能被误解。解释讽刺新闻文章具有挑战性，因为需要结合近期和本地背景。这是一项探索澳大利亚和美国讽刺新闻文章解释生成的初步研究，并将两者进行了比较。该论文表明，在开放权重模型上基于不可靠叙述者理论构建解释是一种可行且经济高效的替代前沿模型的方法。我们发现，模型在识别美国来源文章中的讽刺手法上比澳大利亚来源文章更准确。这项工作产生了一个新的数据集和讽刺解释的评价基准。

articles.title: Fear Is Not Always Fear: Variation in Emotion Label Equivalence Across Datasets
articles.abstract: Emotion classifiers are routinely applied beyond their training data, on the assumption that same-named labels such as fear or surprise mean the same thing across resources. We test this assumption for five labels shared by GoEmotions, XED, and BRIGHTER, comparing models on identical inputs and under cross-corpus transfer. On the same texts, one fear classifier flags 71% as fearful and another 8%, yet the two largely agree on how the texts rank. Across 30 resource-label comparisons, training-label prevalence explains about half of this kind of scale mismatch, and a fitted intercept removes most of it. What recalibration cannot repair is larger: transferred models lose 55% of native discrimination in aggregate, agreement in ranking between classifiers is only weakly related to that loss, and for surprise the resources disagree about which texts express the emotion. The choice of training resource can therefore change conclusions: on two external tweet collections, BRIGHTER- and XED-trained classifiers give opposite answers about which shows more surprise, even after rank normalization, with intervals excluding zero in both directions. A shared emotion label name does not establish an interchangeable measurement target.
articles.titleCn: 恐惧并不总是恐惧：不同数据集中情绪标签等价性的变化
articles.abstractCn: 情感分类器通常被应用于超出其训练数据范围，其前提是具有相同名称的标签（如恐惧或惊讶）在不同资源中具有相同含义。我们针对GoEmotions、XED和BRIGHTER共有的五个标签进行测试，比较模型在相同输入和跨语料库迁移情况下的表现。在相同文本上，一个恐惧分类器将71%标记为恐惧，而另一个仅标记8%，但两者在文本排序上大体一致。在30组资源-标签比较中，训练标签的普遍性解释了约一半这种规模上的不匹配，而拟合的截距项则消除了大部分差异。但重新校准无法修复的问题是更大的：迁移模型总共损失了55%的本土区分能力，分类器排序的一致性与这种损失只有微弱关联，而对于惊讶，不同资源对哪些文本表达了该情绪存在分歧。因此，训练资源的选择可能改变结论：在两个外部推文集合上，经过BRIGHTER和XED训练的分类器在归一化排序后仍给出相反的答案，两个方向的置信区间均不包含零。共享的情感标签名称并不能确立一个可互换的测量目标。

articles.title: COFFEQA: Counterfactual-Guided Few-Shot Distillation for LLM Question Answering
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to train a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model for resource-constrained environments. However, the process of distillation is typically data-intensive and computationally expensive, particularly for generative tasks. Few-shot distillation offers an alternative by transferring teacher knowledge using limited training samples. However, we observe that few-shot distillation performance is heavily dependent on the choice of these training samples. In fact, we demonstrate that using more uncertain samples near the teacher's decision boundary can significantly deteriorate distillation performance. Motivated by this observation, we propose Counterfactual-guided Few-shot Distillation in Open-book Question Answering (COFFEQA), a novel strategy that aptly uses counterfactuals to provide additional supervision around challenging factual samples. In the generative QA setting, we define a counterfactual as a minimally modified context that induces the teacher to change its response to an alternative answer. We provide geometric insights on how factual-counterfactual pairs can constrain the deviation between the teacher's and student's decision boundaries. We further introduce a new metric, Context Following Difficulty (CFD) that further validates counterfactuals prior to distillation based on agreement with the intended alternative answer and dependence on the modified context. COFFEQA uses CFD-validated factual-counterfactual pairs for few-shot distillation. Experiments across five in-domain and three out-of-domain QA benchmarks using T5 and Qwen2.5 families show that COFFEQA outperforms factual-only distillation baselines under the same few-shot budget. For instance, on TriviaQA, COFFEQA improves over the factual-only baseline by 8.77 average EM points and 9.98 average F1 points under the T5 setting with 32 few-shot pairs.
articles.titleCn: COFFEQA：基于反事实引导的少样本蒸馏方法，用于大型语言模型问答
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏旨在为资源受限的环境训练一个较小的学生模型来模仿较大的教师模型。然而，蒸馏过程通常是数据密集型和计算成本高的，特别是在生成任务中。少样本蒸馏通过使用有限的训练样本转移教师知识提供了一种替代方案。然而，我们观察到少样本蒸馏的性能严重依赖于训练样本的选择。事实上，我们证明了使用靠近教师决策边界的更不确定的样本会显著恶化蒸馏性能。受此观察的启发，我们提出了在开卷问答中基于反事实指导的少样本蒸馏（COFFEQA），这是一种巧妙使用反事实来为具有挑战性的事实样本提供额外监督的新策略。在生成式问答设置中，我们将反事实定义为一个最小修改的上下文，该上下文会诱导教师改变其响应以选择另一个答案。我们提供了几何见解，说明了事实-反事实对如何约束教师和学生决策边界之间的偏差。我们进一步引入了一个新指标，即上下文遵循难度（CFD），该指标在蒸馏之前根据与预期替代答案的一致性和对修改上下文的依赖性来验证反事实。COFFEQA使用CFD验证的事实-反事实对进行少样本蒸馏。在T5和Qwen2.5系列模型上，跨越五个领域内和三个领域外问答基准的实验表明，在相同的少样本预算下，COFFEQA优于仅使用事实的蒸馏基线。例如，在TriviaQA上，在T5设置下使用32对少样本对时，COFFEQA比仅使用事实的基线平均提高了8.77个EM点和9.98个F1点。

articles.title: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
articles.abstract: Web agents increasingly browse, interpret, and act on web content on behalf of users. In many realistic workflows, however, the visual evidence they consume is not neutral: charts and dashboards can be misleading, shaping judgments without issuing any explicit malicious instruction. Unlike chart question answering, Web Agents treat charts as intermediate evidence whose misinterpretation can propagate into concrete downstream actions --- a reliability risk that remains underexplored. We introduce MisVisAgentBench, the first paired executable benchmark for evaluating how misleading visualizations affect Web Agent execution. It comprises 280 task instances in matched clean--misleading pairs that differ only in chart evidence. We further provide a diagnostic framework that isolates misleading-induced failures from baseline task difficulty (Zhu et al., 2025) and captures execution-level effects such as extra browsing steps and decision hesitation. Across thirteen vision-language Web Agents, replacing clean charts with misleading counterparts reduces the average task success rate by more than 34 percentage points. Moreover, these failures predominantly follow the targeted misleading action branch, suggesting that deceptive charts systematically redirect rather than randomly disrupt agent decisions. These results reveal that visualization robustness is a critical yet understudied dimension of Web Agent safety and reliability.
articles.titleCn: 当图表欺骗网络代理：误导性可视化任务配对基准
articles.abstractCn: 网络代理越来越多地代表用户浏览、解释和执行网络内容。然而，在许多实际工作流程中，它们所消费的视觉证据并非中立：图表和仪表盘可能具有误导性，在不发出任何明确的恶意指令的情况下影响判断。与图表问答不同，网络代理将图表视为中间证据，其误读可能传播到具体的下游操作——这是一个尚未充分探索的可靠性风险。我们介绍了MisVisAgentBench，这是首个用于评估误导性可视化如何影响网络代理执行的配对可执行基准。它包含280个匹配的干净—误导性对任务实例，这些实例仅在图表证据上有所不同。我们进一步提供了一个诊断框架，该框架能够将误导性引起的失败与基线任务难度（Zhu等人，2025年）分离，并捕捉执行层面的影响，如额外的浏览步骤和决策犹豫。在十三种视觉语言网络代理中，用误导性图表替换干净图表使平均任务成功率降低了超过34个百分点。此外，这些失败主要遵循目标误导性行动分支，表明欺骗性图表系统地重定向代理决策，而非随机干扰。这些结果揭示了可视化鲁棒性是网络代理安全性和可靠性的一个关键但尚未充分研究的维度。
